title: Selvaag Bolig ASA: Q3 2026: Sold 680 homes for NOK 5 billion year to date
body:
Year to date, Selvaag Bolig has sold 680 homes for NOK 4,989 million gross.
The sales value for the first nine months exceeds the company's previous
full-year sales value record. In the third quarter, the company sold 112 homes
for NOK 774 million gross.
Net sales year to date, meaning sales adjusted for Selvaag Bolig's share in
joint ventures, amounted to 625 homes with a total sales value of NOK 4,531
million. Net sales in the third quarter were 95 homes for a total of NOK 643
million.
In Sweden, construction of the first phase of Terrasskvarteret Pluss in
Stockholm started during the quarter. Terrasskvarteret Pluss is being
developed as part of Selvaag Bolig's Pluss concept, where buyers get their own
home combined with access to shared facilities, hosts and services designed to
support community and make everyday life easier. The construction start marks
an important milestone for the company's business in Sweden, where Selvaag
Bolig in recent years has established its own organisation and project
portfolio in the Stockholm region. Following the conversion of booking
agreements into binding purchase agreements, more than 65 per cent of the
project's sales value has been sold.
"We are pleased with sales year to date, particularly against the backdrop of
a still cautious new-build housing market. Sales in Stockholm have made an
important contribution and account for around one fifth of the gross sales
value in the first nine months. The construction start for Terrasskvarteret
Pluss in Stockholm is also an important step in the development of our Swedish
business," says CEO Sverre Molvik.
"We have around 600 homes for sale and plan new sales launches in line with
demand. Solid sales year to date have enabled us to maintain more than 1,000
homes under construction. The market for new homes is still affected by
uncertainty, but demand for our projects and housing concepts has been good,"
says Molvik.
During the third quarter, Selvaag Bolig started construction of 119 homes. A
total of 226 homes were completed, and 186 homes were delivered to buyers, all
from consolidated project companies. Year to date, the company has started
construction of 575 homes, completed 468 homes and delivered 397 homes to
buyers.
At the end of the third quarter, Selvaag Bolig had 1,019 homes under
construction and 93 completed homes that remained unsold. In addition, the
company had 44 completed homes that had been sold but not yet delivered to
buyers. At the end of the third quarter of 2025, the company had 1,051 homes
under construction, 38 completed homes that remained unsold and 28 completed
homes that had been sold but not yet delivered to buyers.
By comparison, Selvaag Bolig sold 93 homes gross for NOK 674 million in the
third quarter of 2025. Net sales amounted to 85 homes for NOK 600 million. In
the first nine months of 2025, Selvaag Bolig sold 406 homes gross for NOK
2,689 million. Net sales amounted to 360 homes for NOK 2,328 million.
Units sold comprise sales contracts entered into with customers pursuant to
the Norwegian Housing Construction Act and the Swedish Tenant-Owners'
Associations Act, as well as booking agreements in Sweden.
Booking agreements are used in Sweden for the sale of new tenant-owned
apartments (BRF), where the buyer pays a booking fee to secure priority for a
home. The booking agreement is not binding, and if the buyer withdraws, part
of the booking fee will be refunded. The booking agreement is converted into a
binding purchase agreement ahead of construction start.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
About Us
Selvaag Bolig ASA is a residential development company that manages the entire
value chain from acquisition of land to completed residential and urban areas.
The company represents a continuation of Selvaag's 75-year history and
experience and has several thousand homes under development in growth areas in
and around the largest cities in Norway and Sweden. Selvaag Bolig offers a
broad variety of housing types, including the lifestyle concept Selvaag
Pluss®, which features homes with shared spaces and services.
www.selvaagboligasa.no/en

sustainability, Selvaag Bolig ASA.

title: Selvaag Bolig ASA: Q3 2026: Har solgt 680 boliger for 5 milliarder kroner hittil i år
body:
Hittil i år har Selvaag Bolig solgt 680 boliger for 4 989 millioner kroner
brutto. Salgsverdien for årets første ni måneder overstiger selskapets
tidligere helårsrekord for salgsverdi. I tredje kvartal solgte selskapet 112
boliger for 774 millioner kroner brutto.
Nettosalget hittil i år, det vil si justert for Selvaag Boligs andel i
samarbeidsprosjekter, utgjorde 625 boliger med en samlet salgsverdi på 4 531
millioner kroner. Nettosalget i tredje kvartal var 95 boliger for til sammen
643 millioner kroner.
I Sverige ble det i kvartalet igangsatt bygging av første del av
Terrasskvarteret Pluss i Stockholm. Prosjektet utvikles som en del av Selvaag
Pluss-konseptet, der kjøperne får egen bolig kombinert med tilgang til
fellesarealer, vertskap og tjenester som legger til rette for fellesskap og en
enklere hverdag. Byggestarten markerer en viktig milepæl for selskapets
satsing i Sverige, hvor Selvaag Bolig de siste årene har etablert egen
organisasjon og prosjektportefølje i Stockholmsregionen. Etter konvertering
fra bokningsavtaler til bindende kjøpsavtaler er mer enn 65 prosent av
salgsverdien i prosjektet solgt.
-- Vi er godt fornøyde med salget hittil i år, særlig sett i lys av et
fortsatt avventende nyboligmarked. Salget i Stockholm har gitt et viktig
bidrag og utgjør om lag en femtedel av brutto salgsverdi i årets første ni
måneder. Byggestarten for Terrasskvarteret Pluss er samtidig et viktig steg i
utviklingen av satsingen vår i Sverige, sier administrerende direktør Sverre
Molvik.
-- Vi har om lag 600 boliger for salg og planlegger nye salgsstarter i takt
med etterspørselen. Det gode salget hittil i år har gjort at vi har
opprettholdt et nivå på mer enn 1 000 boliger i produksjon. Markedet for nye
boliger er fortsatt preget av usikkerhet, men etterspørselen etter prosjektene
og boligkonseptene våre har vært god, sier Molvik.
Selvaag Bolig igangsatte bygging av 119 boliger i tredje kvartal. Det ble
ferdigstilt 226 boliger og 186 boliger ble overlevert til kjøper, alle fra
konsoliderte prosjektselskaper. Hittil i år er det igangsatt bygging av 575
boliger, 468 boliger er ferdigstilt og 397 boliger er overlevert til kjøper.
Ved utgangen av tredje kvartal hadde Selvaag Bolig 1 019 boliger under bygging
og 93 ferdigstilte boliger som ikke var solgt. I tillegg hadde selskapet 44
ferdigstilte boliger som var solgt, men ennå ikke overlevert. Ved utgangen av
tredje kvartal 2025 hadde selskapet 1 051 boliger under bygging, 38
ferdigstilte boliger som ikke var solgt og 28 ferdigstilte boliger som var
solgt men ennå ikke overlevert.
Til sammenligning solgte Selvaag Bolig 93 boliger brutto for 674 millioner
kroner i tredje kvartal 2025. Nettosalget var på 85 boliger for 600 millioner
kroner. I løpet av de ni første månedene av 2025 solgte Selvaag Bolig 406
boliger brutto for 2 689 millioner kroner. Nettosalget var på 360 boliger for
2 328 millioner kroner.
Solgte enheter er inngåtte salgskontrakter med kunder i henhold til
Bustadoppføringslova i Norge og Bostadsrättslagen i Sverige, samt
bokningsavtaler i Sverige.
Bokningsavtaler brukes i Sverige ved salg av nye borettslagsleiligheter (BRF),
der kjøper betaler et bokningsgebyr for å sikre seg prioritet til en bolig.
Bokningsavtalen er ikke bindende, og dersom kjøperen trekker seg vil deler av
bokningsgebyret bli refundert. Bokningsavtalen omgjøres til en bindende
kjøpsavtale i forkant av byggestart.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Om oss
Selvaag Bolig ASA er et boligutviklingsselskap som styrer hele verdikjeden fra
kjøp av tomt til ferdige bolig- og byområder. Selskapet viderefører Selvaags
75 år lange historie og erfaring og har flere tusen boliger under utvikling i
vekstområder i og rundt de største byene i Norge og Sverige. Selvaag Bolig har
et bredt utvalg boligtyper, og tilbyr blant annet livsstilkonseptet Selvaag
Pluss® som er boliger med fellesarealer og tjenester.
www.selvaagboligasa.no (http://www.selvaagboligasa.no/)

Scatec starts construction of the 900 MW Shadwan wind project in Egypt
body:
Oslo/Cairo, 01 October 2026: Scatec ASA ("Scatec"), a leading renewable energy
solutions provider, in partnership with EDF power solutions ("EDF"), has
started construction of the 900 MW Shadwan onshore wind project in Egypt. In
connection with the project, Scatec has signed equity bridge loan (EBL)
agreements totalling USD 150 million with The Arab Energy Fund (TAEF). The
3-year EBL facility comprises USD 50 million for Shadwan and USD 100 million
for the 1,950 MW solar 3,935 MWh BESS Energy Valley project.
Scatec has also signed a joint development agreement with EDF, for a targeted
equity stake of 29% in Shadwan, and intends to invite additional equity
partners into the project.
The 900 MW Shadwan project with a total capex of USD 716 million will be one
of the largest onshore wind farms in Africa. The project is expected to
generate approximately 4 TWh annually and avoid an estimated 1.6 million tons
of CO2 emissions annually. Shadwan will be delivered through Scatec's highly
capital-efficient integrated model, optimising Scatec's equity funding
requirement by combining the equity bridge loan from TAEF with cash flows
generated from Scatec's D&C activities.
"Reaching these milestones reflects the scale and momentum of what Scatec is
building in Egypt. Shadwan and Energy Valley together represent a significant
step in our ambition to develop a world-class renewable energy portfolio in
one of the most attractive markets for cost-efficient, secure and clean
energy. The support from The Arab Energy Fund is a strong vote of confidence
in both projects and enables us to initiate construction of Shadwan with
limited capital deployment," says Scatec CEO Terje Pilskog.
"Shadwan represents a step forward in the development of EDF Power Solutions
in Egypt, under its successful partnership with Scatec. Capitalizing on
Egypt's exceptional wind resources, Shadwan will provide competitive,
low-carbon electricity, supporting the country's ambition to accelerate the
implementation of renewable energy projects," says EDF power solutions CEO
Béatrice Buffon.
"Our financing for Shadwan and Energy Valley reflects TAEF's commitment to
supporting critical energy infrastructure that advances energy security and
sustainability. We are pleased to partner with Scatec in enabling these
large-scale renewable energy projects and supporting Egypt's evolving energy
landscape," said Nicolas Thevenot, Chief Banking Officer of The Arab Energy
Fund.
Scatec has signed mandate letters with a consortium of development finance
institutions for long-term non-recourse project financing at attractive terms,
with financial close for both projects and construction start also for Energy
Valley expected by year end. Scatec will deliver Engineering, Procurement and
Construction (EPC), Asset Management (AM) and Operations & Maintenance (O&M)
services for both projects. Shadwan will be built in phases with the first
phase expected to reach COD at the end of 2027.
About The Arab Energy Fund
The Arab Energy Fund is a multilateral impact financial institution focused on
the MENA energy and utility sectors, established in 1975 by ten Arab
oil-exporting countries. The Arab Energy Fund's mission is to support the
energy ecosystem with debt and equity solutions to enable energy security and
sustainability and to develop local value chains and services in the MENA
region. The Arab Energy Fund creates impact by contributing to economic
prosperity and enabling local communities via talent development and knowledge
creation. The Arab Energy Fund offers a comprehensive range of funding
solutions across the entire energy value chain to leading public and private
sector business partners in over 35 markets. The Arab Energy Fund applies
best-practice ESG principles across all operations, with environmental and
socially linked projects comprising c. 25% of its USD 6.38bn loan portfolio.
The Arab Energy Fund is the only energy-focused financial institution in the
MENA region rated Aa2' by Moody's, AA+' by Fitch and AA-' by S&P.
About EDF power solutions
EDF power solutions is an international energy player which develops, builds
and operates renewable and low-carbon energy production facilities as well as
flexible power and electricity transmission solutions. As a major player in
energy transition worldwide, EDF power solutions deploys, within the EDF
Group, competitive, responsible and value-creating projects in more than 20
countries.
For further information, please contact:

Andreas Austrell, SVP Investor Relations
andreas.austrell@scatec.com
For media:
Meera Bhatia, SVP External Affairs & Communications
meera.bhatia@scatec.com
About Scatec
Scatec is a leading renewable energy solutions provider, accelerating access
to reliable and affordable clean energy in emerging markets. As a long-term
player, we develop, build, own, and operate renewable energy plants, with 6.6
GW generation and 2 GWh storage capacity in operation and under construction
across five continents. We are committed to growing our renewable energy
portfolio, delivered by our passionate employees and partners who are driven
by a common vision of Improving our Future'. Scatec is headquartered in Oslo,
Norway and listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol SCATC'.
To learn more, visit www.scatec.com or connect with us on LinkedIn.

title: Endúr ASA – Pre-project contract award Artec Aqua VAQ
category: ADDITIONAL REGULATED INFORMATION REQUIRED TO BE DISCLOSED UNDER THE LAWS OF A MEMBER STATE
body:
Endúr ASA (“Endúr”) is happy to announce that its wholly owned subsidiary, Artec Aqua VAQ AS (“Artec Aqua VAQ”), has been awarded a contract by the Gaia Salmon Holding AS (“Gaia Salmon”) bankruptcy estate for the engineering and planning phase of the modification and completion of Gaia Salmon’s land-based recirculating aquaculture system (RAS) facility at Træna, Norway. The scope includes a detailed condition assessment, identification and engineering of required rehabilitation measures, technical documentation, coordination of subcontractor quotations, definition of the scope of supply, and preparation of a complete cost estimate and overall schedule for the subsequent execution phase. The pre-project will commence immediately. The execution phase will be subject to Gaia Salmon’s final investment decision (“FID”), which is expected during the first quarter of 2027.
(ENDS)

Endúr ASA (XOSL: ENDUR) is a leading Scandinavian contractor headquartered in Lysaker and listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange. The company specializes in critical infrastructure, including bridges, quays, tunnels, and dams. Operating as a disciplined serial acquirer (compounder), the group utilizes a decentralized model that grants subsidiaries high autonomy to preserve their technical expertise and local market positions. Endúr drives long-term value through strategic platform acquisitions and targeted bolt-ons in fragmented niche markets.

AKVA group ASA: Agreement between AKVA group and Yanmar on a recommended voluntary cash offer for all shares in AKVA group
body:
NOT FOR RELEASE, PUBLICATION OR DISTRIBUTION, IN WHOLE OR IN PART, DIRECTLY OR
INDIRECTLY, INTO OR WITHIN AUSTRALIA, CANADA, HONG KONG, NEW ZEALAND, SOUTH
AFRICA AND SOUTH KOREA, OR ANY JURISDICTION IN WHICH THE RELEASE, PUBLICATION OR
DISTRIBUTION WOULD BE UNLAWFUL.
The Agreement
The Board of Directors of AKVA group ASA ("AKVA", "AKVA group", or the
"Company") and Pontos Bidco AS (the "Offeror"), a Norwegian private limited
liability company indirectly owned by Yanmar Holdings Co., Ltd. ("Yanmar"), are
pleased to announce that they have entered into a transaction agreement (the
"Transaction Agreement") for a recommended voluntary cash offer (the "Offer") by
the Offeror to acquire all issued and outstanding shares in AKVA (the "Shares",
and each a "Share").
A cash consideration of NOK 161 (the "Offer Price") will be offered for each
Share. The Offer Price represents a premium of:
 * 57% compared to the undisturbed, dividend adjusted closing trading price of
 NOK 102.5 for the Shares on Euronext Oslo Børs on 7 April 2026, being the
 last trading day prior to announcement of AKVA's strategic review;
 * 62% compared to the 30-trading days dividend adjusted volume weighted
 average share price of NOK 99.3 in the period ending 7 April 2026; and
 * 67% compared to the 60-trading days dividend adjusted volume weighted
 average share price of NOK 96.2 in the period ending 7 April 2026.
Board recommendation
The Offer is a result of the strategic review initiated by the Board of
Directors of AKVA (the "Board"), as announced on 8 April 2026, with the aim to
maximize shareholder value. Following announcement of the strategic review, the
Company received high-quality interest regarding a potential sale of the
Company, and the Company and its advisors have been in dialogue with several
interested parties to evaluate the viability and the potential terms for a
transaction.
After careful consideration of the Company's available options, the Board's
assessment is that the Offer represents the most attractive alternative to
maximize shareholder value. The Board has therefore unanimously resolved to
recommend that the shareholders accept the Offer.
The Board believes that Yanmar, as a long-term industrial owner, can support
AKVA in realizing its long-term potential through access to complementary
technologies, global capabilities and resources.
The complete statement of the Board regarding the Offer (the "Board
Recommendation") is appended to this notice. The Board Recommendation is not
made pursuant to Sections 6-16 and 6-19 of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act
and a separate statement will, pursuant to a decision by the Norwegian Financial
Supervisory Authority (the "NFSA"), be made by an independent third party in
this respect.
Pre-Acceptances
Shareholders in AKVA representing approximately 92% of the Shares (excluding the
Company's treasury shares), have undertaken, subject to customary conditions, to
tender their shares into the Offer (the "Irrevocable Undertakings"). The
Irrevocable Undertakings may not be withdrawn in the event of the launch of a
competing offer. Shareholders who have given Irrevocable Undertakings include:
 * Egersund Group AS
 * Israel Corporation LTD
 * all members of the Board and the executive management of AKVA
 * Pareto Asset Management AS, including discretionary portfolios managed by
 Pareto Asset Management AS
 * Nordea Investment Management AB
 * Alfred Berg
As part of the Irrevocable Undertakings, the committed shareholders have agreed
not to directly or indirectly, solicit, encourage, invite or seek alternative
proposals for any competitive offer.
Identity of the Offeror and strategic rationale
The Offeror is Pontos Bidco AS (pending name change from NFH 260570 AS),
business registration no. 937 943 121, a newly established Norwegian limited
liability company indirectly owned by Yanmar.
Yanmar is a diversified global industrial group with over a century of
engineering heritage and a deeply rooted culture of innovation. Founded in
1912, Yanmar is a family-owned business now led by Takehito Yamaoka, President
and Representative Director.
Yanmar has over time evolved from its origins in diesel engine manufacturing
into a broad industrial conglomerate serving multiple end markets, including
agriculture, marine, construction industrial engines and energy systems. Today,
Yanmar operates across the globe with the majority of its revenues generated
outside Japan.
As a family-owned company, Yanmar has maintained a long-term strategic
orientation that emphasizes innovation, technological excellence, product
reliability, strong customer ties embedded in a reliable global aftermarket
services platform and sustained value creation.
Yanmar has an impressive track record of acquiring and integrating businesses to
accelerate growth and has in its dialogue with the Board expressed its
conviction that completion of the Offer would establish a strong platform for
long-term value creation by combining complementary technologies, expanding
global market reach, and strengthening the combined groups' position as a
trusted partner to the global aquaculture industry. Yanmar has expressed that
the Offer is intended to provide AKVA a platform to scale, by leveraging
Yanmar's capabilities, global resources and patient capital, as a long-term
industrial owner.
"AKVA has built a unique position in the global aquaculture industry over more
than five decades. Following a comprehensive strategic review and with strong
support from our largest shareholders, we believe the Offer represents the best
solution for both AKVA and our current shareholders. By combining AKVA's
industry-leading aquaculture expertise with Yanmar's global industrial
capabilities, technology base and long-term ownership perspective, we see
substantial potential to create value for customers and further strengthen the
Company's growth and innovation agenda," says Knut Nesse, CEO of AKVA Group.

body:
DNB Bank ASA ("DNB") has completed the share buy-back programme announced on 14
July 2026.
A total of 9,508,388 shares, which equals 0.66 percent of the shares in the
company, were purchased on trading venues, for a total consideration of NOK
2,953 million. The average price paid per share was NOK 310.54. Following this,

At the same meeting it will also be proposed to redeem 9,796,520 shares, which

represented by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Fisheries ("NFD"). The
purpose of this is to ensure that NFD's ownership interest of 34 percent remains
unchanged. NFD will receive a total consideration of NOK 2,950 million and an
interest compensation.

title: Grieg Seafood ASA (OSE: GSF): Abnormal mortality in September impacts harvest volume and farming cost guidance for full year 2026
category: ADDITIONAL REGULATED INFORMATION REQUIRED TO BE DISCLOSED UNDER THE LAWS OF A MEMBER STATE
body:
From a strong biology at sea throughout August, Grieg Seafood experienced a
negative development at one site, causing elevated mortality during September
2026. The mortality is due to an unexpected algae event causing gill damage.
Mortality rose gradually throughout September. The Company closely monitored
the situation and is implementing measures to mitigate the impact, including
temporary suspension of harvest which is reflected in the new guidance below.
The company has now determined that the cumulative impact has reached the
threshold for formal disclosure.
Based on the information currently available, the total biomass loss
associated with the event is estimated at approximately 1,000 tonnes.
The increased mortality is expected to impact both harvest volume and farming
cost for the full year 2026. As a result, Grieg Seafood revises its full year
guidance as follows:
* Harvest volume: Revised from 31,000 tonnes to 29,000 tonnes
* Farming cost: Revised from 67.5 NOK/kg to 71.0 NOK/kg
The increase in farming cost primarily reflects the reduced harvest volume and
the financial impact associated with the mortality event. The mortality event
will not impact the production for 2027.
Grieg Seafood continues to assess the operational and financial consequences
of the event and will provide further information in connection with its
ordinary financial reporting
For further enquiries, please contact:
Nina W. Grieg, Chief Executive Officer
+47 953 39 161
Magnus Johannesen, Chief Financial Officer
+47 959 13 243
About Grieg Seafood ASA 
Grieg Seafood ASA is one of the world's leading salmon farmers. Our farms are
located in Rogaland in Norway with our headquarter in Bergen, Norway. Grieg
Seafood ASA was listed at the Oslo Stock Exchange in June 2007. Sustainable
farming practices are the foundation of Grieg Seafood's operations. The lowest
possible environmental impact and the best possible fish welfare is both an
ethical responsibility and drive economic profitability.
To learn more, please visit www.griegseafood.com.

Elmera Group ASA – Settlement notification and results for the recommended voluntary cash tender offer from Fortum
Reference is made to the recommended voluntary cash offer by Fortum Consumer Solutions AS (the "Offeror"), a company wholly owned by Fortum Oyj (“Fortum”), to acquire all issued and outstanding shares in Elmera Group ASA (“Elmera”), except for shares owned by Elmera, at a price of NOK 47 per share on the terms and conditions set out in the offer document dated 20 August 2026 (the “Offer Document”) (the “Offer”). Reference is further made to the stock exchange announcement published on 18 September 2026 (the “Offer Extension Announcement”) regarding extension of the period where shareholders of Elmera may continue to accept the Offer until 2 October 2026 at 16:30 CEST (the “Offer Period”).
The Offer Period expired at 16:30 CEST on 2 October 2026.
As of expiry of the Offer Period, and subject to customary verifications of acceptances received, the Offeror had received acceptances from Elmera shareholders under the Offer for 104,755,535 shares, representing approximately 91.61% of the issued and outstanding share capital and voting rights of Elmera (95.80% excluding Elmera’s treasury shares).
As announced on 3 September 2026, the Closing Condition relating to “Regulatory Approvals” as set out in Section 3.4 (c) "Conditions for completion of the Offer" of the Offer Document (as defined and described in the Offer Document) has been satisfied. As announced on 25 September 2026, and subject to customary verification of acceptances received, the Closing Condition relating to “Minimum Acceptance” as set out in Section 3.4 (a) “Conditions for completion of the Offer” of the Offer Document (as defined and described in the Offer Document) has also been satisfied.
This announcement constitutes the settlement notification pursuant to section 3.11 “Settlement of the Offer” of the Offer Document. Settlement of the Offer shall take place pursuant to the terms and conditions of the Offer Document and is currently expected to take place on or about 23 October 2026 and will be made to shareholders of Elmera having validly accepted the Offer in accordance with the terms as set out in Offer Document. Settlement of the Offer is subject to the other Closing Conditions set out in Section 3.4 “Conditions for completion of the Offer” of the Offer Document (as defined and described in the Offer Document) continuing to be satisfied until settlement of the Offer or being waived by the Offeror in its sole discretion. 
Subject to and following completion of the Offer and provided that the relevant conditions are satisfied, the Offeror intends to carry out a compulsory acquisition of the remaining shares of Elmera. Further, subject to and following completion of the Offer, the Offeror also intends to take steps to delist Elmera’s shares from Euronext Oslo Børs. 
Except for the extension of the Offer Period as set out in the Offer Extension Announcement, the complete terms and conditions for the Offer, including detailed information regarding settlement, are set out in the Offer Document.
Subject to regulatory restrictions in certain jurisdictions, the Offer Document is available at the following webpage: www.paretosec.com/transactions.
Advisors
Advokatfirmaet BAHR AS is acting as legal advisor to the Offeror, while Pareto Securities AS is acting as financial advisor to the Offeror. Advokatfirmaet Haavind AS is acting as legal advisor to Elmera, while ABG Sundal Collier ASA is acting as its financial advisor.

title: LINK Mobility - LINK acquires LabsMobile to strengthen position in Spain and expand presence in Latin America
category: ADDITIONAL REGULATED INFORMATION REQUIRED TO BE DISCLOSED UNDER THE LAWS OF A MEMBER STATE
body:
(Oslo, 5 October 2026) - LINK Mobility ("LINK") has acquired 001Tech S.L., operating under the brand name LabsMobile, a Spanish provider of SMS and messaging solutions founded in 2009, serving more than 3,000 customers across Spain and Latin America.
Through the acquisition, LINK further strengthens its position in Spain and expands its presence across Latin America. Approximately 27% of LabsMobile's revenue is generated in Spain, while around 2/3 originates from Latin America, primarily Mexico and Colombia. The company has demonstrated strong growth over recent years and is expected to achieve a gross profit CAGR of 37% from 2023 to 2026. 
LabsMobile operates primarily as a single-channel SMS provider, creating opportunities to cross-sell LINK's broader product portfolio, including WhatsApp Business and RCS, to more than 3,000 customers across Spain and Latin America.
LINK expects to benefit from procurement and routing optimization opportunities, supporting further margin expansion. LINK has acquired LabsMobile for a cash consideration of EUR 2.4 million The transaction corresponds to an EV/FY25 adjusted EBITDA multiple of approximately 6.5x. 
For further information, please contact: 
Christian Nygaard, IR & Corporate Strategy Manager 
+47 45 40 33 22 
ir@linkmobility.com 
About LINK Mobility 
LINK is an award-winning, leading global provider of mobile messaging and communications platform as a service (CPaaS) solutions for increased engagement. The company serves enterprise, SME and government customers. LINK offers a wide range of innovative and scalable mobile solutions, creating valuable digital convergence between businesses and customers, governments and citizens, platforms and users. LINK has 68,000 active customer accounts globally and exchanges more than 40 billion messages a year on a proforma basis. LINK is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange under the ticker LINK. For more information about LINK, please see www.linkmobility.com and follow LINK Mobility on LinkedIn.

title: Norwegian Air Shuttle ASA (NAS) - Traffic Figures for September 2026
body:
In September, the Norwegian Group had 2.8 million passengers, of which Norwegian had 2.4 million and Widerøe 394,000. The load factor for Norwegian increased to 87.1 percent, while Widerøe continues to deliver world-class punctuality.
"I am pleased that we have delivered a higher load factor while also increasing capacity, as we did in August. The autumn holidays in all the Nordic countries are showing high demand, and we are experiencing many full flights across our core markets. Looking ahead, the winter period is also showing solid promising booking numbers," said Geir Karlsen, CEO of Norwegian.
Norwegian's capacity (ASK) in September was 3,833 million seat kilometres, an increase of 6 percent compared with September 2025. Actual passenger traffic (RPK) was 3,339 million seat kilometres, an increase of 7 percent from the same period last year. The load factor was 87.1 percent, up 0.6 percentage points. Regularity, the share of scheduled flights that took place, was 99.4 percent. Punctuality, the share of flights departing within 15 minutes of scheduled time, was 84.3 percent. In September, Norwegian operated an average of 94 aircraft.
"On 30 September, we took delivery of two brand new 737 MAX 8 aircraft from Boeing facilities in Seattle, which marked aircraft delivery number 200 and 201 in Norwegian's history. The current fuel price levels are creating headwinds, but we are managing this with seasonally optimised capacity as well as our hedge positions in the coming months. For the winter period, both winter warm destinations, such as Egypt and the Canary Islands, and city breaks, such as London and Berlin, are performing well. We are seeing that while the Nordic passengers travel for sun and Christmas markets, demand from tourists going the other way is also looking promising. Rovaniemi and Tromsø, in addition to the Nordic capitals, are popular destinations for incoming tourists," said Geir Karlsen, CEO of Norwegian.
Widerøe's capacity (ASK) was 208 million seat kilometres in September, up 3 percent from the previous year. Actual passenger traffic (RPK) was 149 million seat kilometres, up 1 percent from September 2025. The load factor was 71.8 percent, down 1.6 percentage points from last year. Punctuality was 94.5 percent, an increase of 0.5 percent from last year. This ranks Widerøe as one of the top airlines in the world on punctuality once again. Regularity was 98.2 percent in September.
"We are continuing to deliver world class punctuality thanks to all our great colleagues and their hard work. This is important not only for Widerøe, but for our passengers and all the local communities we serve across the country," said Tore Jenssen, CEO of Widerøe.
See detailed traffic figures in the attached PDF.

title: DNB gjennomfører organisatoriske endringer i Technology & Services
body:
DNB investerer betydelig i teknologi, kunstig intelligens og digitale løsninger
for å møte kundenes forventninger til enkle, raske og tilgjengelige
banktjenester. For å levere bedre kundeopplevelser, øke effektiviteten og møte
framtidige kundebehov gjennomfører DNB organisatoriske endringer og nedbemanning
som en del av en bredere omstilling i Technology & Services (T&S).
Gjennom de siste årene har DNB forenklet en rekke interne prosesser og rutiner.
Konsernet har samtidig tatt i bruk agentisk, kunstig intelligens i flere deler
av virksomheten. Teknologien erstatter oppgaver som tidligere ble håndtert
manuelt og bidrar til raskere prosesser, økt kapasitet og en enklere hverdag for
kundene. Kontroll av kundedata og arbeidet med "kjenn din kunde"-prosessen (KYC)
samt teknologiutvikling og koding er områder der banken allerede ser at KI
-agenter kan bidra til betydelige effektivitetsgevinster.
For å realisere disse gevinstene og utnytte mulighetene som ligger i ny
teknologi og nye arbeidsprosesser, vil DNB tilpasse organisering og
kompetansesammensetning i T&S. Endringene innebærer en reduksjon i bemanningen
på om lag 400 årsverk.
- Kunstig intelligens endrer hvordan vi jobber og hvordan vi leverer tjenester
til kundene våre. Vi ser allerede betydelige gevinster, og derfor tilpasser vi
nå organisasjonen til en ny virkelighet. Samtidig vet vi at denne omstillingen
berører medarbeidere som har bidratt sterkt til DNB gjennom mange år. Derfor er
det viktig for oss å gjennomføre prosessen på en ryddig og ansvarlig måte, og
ivareta de som blir berørt på best mulig måte, sier konsernsjef Kjerstin
Braathen.
DNB vil gjennomføre prosessen i tråd med gjeldende regelverk og i tett dialog
med de tillitsvalgte.
Restruktureringskostnader vil bli regnskapsført i fjerde kvartal 2026, og
nedbemanningen vil gjennomføres i løpet av fjerde kvartal 2026 med full
regnskapsmessig kostnadseffekt fra andre kvartal 2027. Ytterligere informasjon
om de finansielle effektene av omstillingen vil bli offentliggjort senere i år.

title: DNB is making organisational changes in Technology & Services
body:
DNB is investing considerably in technology, artificial intelligence (AI) and
digital solutions to meet its customers' expectations of simple, fast and
available banking services. In order to deliver better customer experiences,
increase efficiency and meet customers' future needs, DNB is carrying out
organisational changes and downsizing as part of a comprehensive restructuring
of Technology & Services (T&S).
During the past few years, DNB has simplified a number of internal processes and
routines. At the same time, the Group has adopted agentic AI in several parts of
its operations. This technology replaces tasks that were previously handled
manually and contributes to faster processes and increased capacity, and it
simplifies life for our customers. Control of customer data and the work
relating to the Know Your Customer (KYC) process, as well as technology
development and coding, are areas where the bank is already seeing that AI
agents can contribute substantial efficiency gains.
To achieve these gains and exploit the opportunities associated with new
technology and new work processes, DNB will adapt the organisation of T&S and
its skills mix. The changes entail a reduction in the workforce of about 400
full-time equivalents (FTEs).
"AI is changing the way we work and how we deliver services to our customers. We
are already seeing considerable gains, and are therefore adapting our
organisation to a new reality. At the same time, we know that this restructuring
will affect employees who have made a strong contribution to DNB for many years.
This is why it is important for us to carry out an orderly and responsible
process, and take care of the employees affected in the best possible way," says
Group Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Kjerstin Braathen.
DNB will carry out the process in accordance with applicable rules and
legislation, and in close dialogue with the employee representatives.
The restructuring costs will be recognised in the accounts in the fourth quarter
of 2026, and the downsizing will be completed during the fourth quarter of 2026,
with the effect relating to costs fully recognised in the accounts from the
second quarter of 2027. Further information about the financial effects of the
restructuring process will be disclosed later this year.

body:
NOT FOR PUBLICATION, DISTRIBUTION OR RELEASE, IN WHOLE OR IN PART, DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY, IN OR INTO THE UNITED STATES, AUSTRALIA, CANADA, HONG KONG OR JAPAN, EXCEPT AS PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, OR ANY OTHER JURISDICTION IN WHICH THE PUBLICATION, DISTRIBUTION OR RELEASE WOULD BE UNLAWFUL OR REQUIRES ANY OTHER REGISTRATION MEASURES.
6 October 2026
Wallenius Wilhelmsen ASA ("WAWI", the "Company", OSE ticker code: WAWI) is contemplating a private placement (the "Private Placement") of new shares in the Company (the "Offer Shares") to raise gross proceeds of the NOK equivalent of USD 300 million. The Private Placement is directed towards investors subject to and in compliance with applicable exemptions from relevant prospectus or registration requirements. The Company has engaged DNB Carnegie, a part of DNB Bank ASA as sole global coordinator and joint bookrunner (the "Global Coordinator"), and ABG Sundal Collier ASA, Nordea Bank Abp NUF and Skandinaviska Enskilda Banken AB (publ), Oslo Branch as joint bookrunners in the Private Placement (together, the "Managers"). 
Through the Private Placement, the Company is expanding its newbuilding program to strengthen its leading position in the deep-sea RoRo segment. The Company is in advanced discussions with yards to enter into shipbuilding contracts for 4x large dual fuel LNG vessels at attractive terms, with delivery in 2030 and options for additional 8x newbuilds at similar terms, with quarterly deliveries from 2031 and onwards. This decision will extend the newbuilding program to a total of 26 vessels (including options), with steady deliveries from Q3 2026 through 2032, increasing the Company's operating leverage towards a structurally strong car carrier market. 
The net proceeds will, together with debt financing, be used to fully finance the total newbuild program, and for general corporate purposes. The Private Placement will further allow the Company to maintain a robust balance sheet, providing flexibility to pursue attractive growth opportunities as they arise and provide shareholders with a competitive return over time through a combination of rising value for the Wallenius Wilhelmsen share and dividend payments. 
The subscription price per Offer Share (the "Offer Price") and the number of Offer Shares to be issued will be resolved by the Company's board of directors (the "Board") based on an accelerated bookbuilding process. 
The bookbuilding period for the Private Placement will start today, 6 October 2026 at 16:30 (CEST) and will close on 7 October 2026 at 08:00 (CEST). The Company reserves the right to shorten, close or extend the bookbuilding period at any time at its sole discretion, without notice. If the bookbuilding period is shortened or extended, the other dates referred to herein may be changed accordingly. 
The Company's largest shareholder, Wilh. Wilhelmsen Holding ASA ("WWH") has pre-committed to subscribe for its pro-rata share (37.9%) at the Offer Price, but is open to being scaled back to support liquidity, overall investor diversity and quality of demand. Wallenius Lines AB ("Wallenius"), wholly owned by Rederi AB Soya ("Soya Group") remains highly supportive of the Company's strategy and proposed transaction. Due to the size of its Shipping investment relative to the Soya Group's overall portfolio, Wallenius has decided to not participate in the Private Placement. The Company, its primary insiders, WWH and Wallenius have entered into customary lock-up agreements with the Global Coordinator for a period of six months from completion of the Private Placement. 
The Private Placement is offered to investors subject to applicable exemptions from relevant prospectus requirements in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2017/1129 and is directed towards a limited number of selected investors subject to applicable exemptions from relevant registration, filing and prospectus requirements, (i) outside the United Stated in reliance on Regulation S under the US Securities Trading Act of 1933 (the "US Securities Act") and (ii) in the United States only to persons reasonably believed to be "qualified institutional buyers" (QIBs) as defined in rule 144A under the US Securities Act. Applicable selling restrictions will apply. In the United Kingdom, it shall be directed only at persons who are "qualified investors" as defined in paragraph 15 of Schedule 1 to the Public Offers and Admissions to Trading Regulations 2024, and who are (i) persons having professional experience in matters relating to investments who fall within the definition of "investment professionals" in Article 19(5) of the Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (Financial Promotion) Order 2005, as amended (the "Order") or (ii) high net worth entities falling within Article 49(2)(a) to (d) of the Order; or (iii) are other persons to whom it otherwise lawfully may be communicated. The Offer Shares are not to be offered in any other jurisdiction where such an offering would be prohibited by applicable law. 
The minimum order size and allocation in the Private Placement will be the NOK equivalent of EUR 100,000, provided that the Company may, at its sole discretion, offer and allocate an amount below EUR 100,000, pursuant to any applicable exemptions from applicable prospectus requirements being available. 
Allocation of Offer Shares will be made at the discretion of the Board in consultation with the Managers after expiry of the bookbuilding period. title: Salmon Evolution ASA: Q3 2026 operational update
category: ADDITIONAL REGULATED INFORMATION REQUIRED TO BE DISCLOSED UNDER THE LAWS OF A MEMBER STATE
body:
Salmon Evolution (OSE: SALME) enters the final stretch of 2026 with a clear
and narrow set of priorities. Operationally, the organisation is fully focused
on reaching Phase 1 biomass growth targets, and in parallel, the Phase 2
ramp-up is in full effect and progressing as planned. The Phase 2 project is
nearing completion, and with the company gradually taking over the rest of the
facility, preparations are underway for the upcoming smolt releases.
Key summary:
* Harvested 1,596 tonnes HOG at an all-in price realization of ~NOK 65/kg, up
 ~7% y/y; superior share of 94% in line with the long-term trend.
* Net biomass growth of 1,984 tonnes LW, held back by one underperforming
 Phase 1 group representing ~25% of tank capacity in the quarter, now fully
 harvested as planned by end-Q3.
* Average harvest weight of 3.0 kg HOG reflects that group; Q4-26 phase 1
 harvest weights are expected in the mid-to-high end of the 3--4 kg range.
* Phase 2 have the required smolt stocking frequency from Q4-26 to reach
 targeted production run-rate by mid-27.
For further information, please contact:
Trond Håkon Schaug-Pettersen, CEO
thsp@salmone.no
+47 91 19 13 27
Trond Vadset Veibust, CFO
tvv@salmone.no
+47 48 09 05 95
About Salmon Evolution
Salmon Evolution is the global leader within land-based salmon farming.
Pioneering the hybrid flow-through system (HFS), Salmon Evolution is Extending
the Ocean Potential by creating optimal growth conditions in a controlled
environment on land. This approach, capturing the benefits of both land-based
and sea-based farming, puts biology first and limits operational and
biological risk.
Salmon Evolution is strategically located the heart of the global aquaculture
industry on the west coast of Norway, where the Company has its first facility
and global centre of excellence fully operational at industrial scale. Enabled
by proof of concept at Indre Harøy, Salmon Evolution targets significant
expansion.
Salmon Evolution is listed on Oslo Børs under the ticker SALME. To learn more,
please visit www.salmonevolution.no.

body:
Chief Financial Officer Hans-Jørgen Wibstad has decided to leave Norwegian Air Shuttle with effect from 31 October 2026 to take up a new role as CFO in Multiconsult ASA on 1 November, and upon completion of the proposed merger, CFO in Multiconsult Rejlers.
"I am leaving Norwegian as a strong and well positioned airline. Over the last few years, the company has delivered solid financial results, distributed a first ever dividend and initiated key strategic growth initiatives. I would like to wish the company and all its great employees all the best for the future," said Hans-Jørgen Wibstad.
Gjermund Aasen, SVP Corporate Finance & Fleet, has been appointed interim Chief Financial Officer with effect from 1 November 2026. He has been with Norwegian since 2021 and was previously Vice President Finance at Golden Ocean Management AS. He holds a Master of Science in Business Administration from Nord University in Bodø and BI Norwegian Business School.
"I would like to thank Hans-Jørgen for his contribution as CFO of Norwegian since 2022. He has played an important role in the company's development over the last years, and I have valued our close collaboration. Both me and the rest of Norwegian team wish him all the best in his future endeavours. I am also very pleased that Gjermund has agreed to step in as interim CFO. Having worked closely with him, I know his expertise will ensure a seamless transition," said Geir Karlsen, CEO of Norwegian.
The company has initiated a search process to appoint a Chief Financial Officer on a permanent basis.

The prorated gross freight rate in September 2026 was USD 99.0 per cbm (+0.2% vs. the average prorated gross freight rate in Q3 at USD 98.8 per cbm). 
The prorated net freight rate in September 2026 was USD 82.0 per cbm (+1.1% vs. the average prorated net freight rate in Q3 at USD 81.1 per cbm). 
HH/BB share of prorated volume carried in September was 21%. In Q3 the prorated HH/BB share was 23%. 
Andreas Enger, CEO Höegh Autoliners, comments: "September ended a quarter with stable performance in both volume and freight rates, although with some monthly variations. Gross rates have increased in Q3 on gradually increased BAF compensation. While overall demand and outlook remain robust, we continue to see elevated costs related to our Middle East service and higher fuel costs impacting earnings " 
For further information, please contact: 
Investor Relations 
ir@hoegh.com 
About Höegh Autoliners 
Höegh Autoliners is a leading global provider of RoRo (Roll On Roll Off) transportation services delivering cars, high and heavy and breakbulk cargoes across the world. The Company operates around 40 RoRo vessels in global trade systems and makes more than 2 000 port calls each year. Our purpose is to develop innovative solutions for greener and more sustainable deep sea transportation. We are on a path to a zero emissions future and are working closely with customers and partners to achieve this. Höegh Autoliners has its head office in Oslo, Norway and employs around 460 people in its 16 offices worldwide and around 1 200 seafarers.

category: ADDITIONAL REGULATED INFORMATION REQUIRED TO BE DISCLOSED UNDER THE LAWS OF A MEMBER STATE
body:
Oslo, 9 October 2026: BlueNord ASA ("BlueNord" or the "Company") has today
announced its preliminary production figures for September 2026. In September,
preliminary production was 43.9 mboepd net to the Company. The Tyra hub produced
25.2 mboepd, while the base assets, comprising the Dan, Gorm and Halfdan hubs,
contributed18.7 mboepd.
Planned pigging of the Harald-Tyra pipeline was successfully completed during
September. Tyra hub production was impacted by the associated activities and a
few temporary operational events during the month, with fast recovery following
each event. Production averaged 25.2 mboepd net to BlueNord in September.
Average production for the quarter was 26.0 mboepd net to the Company, within
the quarterly guidance range of 25-30 mboepd.
The base assets delivered 18.7 mboepd net to BlueNord in September. Production
from the Halfdan and Gorm hubs was strong throughout the month, with Halfdan
delivering stable production at a preliminary operational efficiency above 95%.
Dan hub production was partially impacted by temporary integrity issues, which
were resolved towards the end of the month with production returning to
expected levels. Average production for the quarter was 17.6 mboepd net to the
Company within the quarterly guidance range of 17-19 mboepd.

of the Norwegian Securities Trading Act.

title: Hunter Group ASA - Business Update on reduced charter hire from one of the counterparties.
body:
Oslo, 9 October 2026
Reference is made to the stock announcements published by Hunter Group ASA (the
"Company") on 15 April 2026 and 18 May 2026 and 9 June 2026 and 21 July 2026 and
10 August 2026 and 8 September 2026 regarding one of the Company's long-term
contractual counterparty's reduced payments of time charter hire in March,
April, May, June, July and August.
The counterparty continues to dispute its contractual obligation and has paid
approximately USD 12,747,000 less than the amount due for September 2026.
The Company and its legal advisors remain confident that the counterparty has no
merit for the reduced payments. The Company considers the counterparty to be in
continued breach of contract and will continue to take all necessary steps to
protect its contractual rights.
The Company will provide updates to the market when appropriate.
For the month of September, the Company recorded net time charter earnings of
approximately USD 60,879,000, of which approximately USD 12,747,000 remains
outstanding pending resolution of the matter described above, increasing the
total disputed amount to approximately USD 67,785,000, plus accrued interest.

category: ADDITIONAL REGULATED INFORMATION REQUIRED TO BE DISCLOSED UNDER THE LAWS OF A MEMBER STATE
body:
Sandnes, Norway, 12 October 2026: Vår Energi ASA (OSE: VAR, the "Company") will
publish its financial report for the third quarter 2026 on Wednesday 21 October.
Today, the Company provides an update on production, sales volumes and other
relevant items.
Vår Energi's net production of oil, liquids and natural gas averaged 369 kboepd
in the third quarter of 2026, a decrease of 2% from the second quarter and flat
compared to the third quarter last year. The Company expects full-year
production of around 390 kboepd, compared to the original guidance of 390-410
kboepd, reflecting operational issues at Johan Castberg and the Jotun FPSO in
July and production irregularities in the Åsgard area. Johan Castberg and Jotun
FPSO have been producing at expected levels since early-August. None of the main
production impacts are reservoir related and have been managed effectively.
The production split in the first quarter was 68% oil and NGLs (liquids) and 32%
gas. Total volumes produced were 34.0 mmboe whereas volumes sold in the quarter
amounted to 34.8 mmboe. The overlift position is mainly due to timing of crude
liftings in the quarter. Vår Energi obtained an average realised price (volume
-weighted) of USD 103 per boe in the quarter. The realised crude price was USD
103 per barrel, representing a premium of USD 6 per barrel compared to dated
Brent. The increase in premium differentials to Brent observed since early
September will be reflected in fourth quarter realised prices, as cargoes are
normally sold weeks ahead of delivery. The realised gas price of USD 108 per boe
is approximately 18 USD below the average spot market reference price. Volumes
sold on gas year ahead and fixed price contracts represented 29% of third
quarter gas volumes sold at an average price of USD 87 per boe. 25% of third
quarter volumes were sold with month ahead indexation in a rising market
(approximately USD 22 per boe below spot), whereas the impact will be the
opposite in a falling market.

Reference is made to stock exchange notice of 16 October 2025, where Endúr ASA ("The Company") announced its plan to prolong a share buy-back program ("The Program") pursuant to the authorization granted by The Annual General Meeting in 2025, and subsequently in 2026.

DOF Group ASA - Awarded Subsea Decommissioning Contract in the North Sea
body:
DOF Group ASA ("DOF") is pleased to announce the award of a Significant*
contract with a North Sea operator for a subsea decommissioning campaign.
The contract scope includes project management, engineering, offshore execution
and disposal services for the removal of subsea infrastructure and seabed
clearance across multiple offshore fields. The offshore campaign is scheduled
for execution during the first quarter of 2027.
DOF will utilise its integrated decommissioning capabilities, combining in-house
engineering, project management, marine operations, ROV services, survey and
offshore execution. Offshore operations will be performed by one of DOF's
Construction Support Vessels (CSVs).
Mons S. Aase, CEO DOF Group, said:
"We are pleased to secure this contract and look forward to delivering a safe
and efficient decommissioning campaign. The award reflects the strength of DOF's
integrated service offering and our ability to execute complex offshore projects
across the full project lifecycle."
The award further strengthens DOF's position within the decommissioning market
and highlights the continued demand for integrated end-of-life solutions for
offshore infrastructure.
*DOF defines a Significant contract as a contract with a value between USD 15
million and USD 25 million.

title: ABGSC - Q3 2026 Interim Report
body:
Highlights:
 - Q3 revenues of NOK 594m (NOK 476m)
 - Q3 diluted EPS of NOK 0.151 (0.136)
 - YTD revenues of NOK 1,735m (NOK 1,453m)
 - YTD diluted EPS of NOK 0.470 (0.405)
CEO comment: Record third-quarter revenues reflect the strength of our
diversified Nordic platform
ABGSC delivered the highest third-quarter revenues to date, increasing by 25%
compared with the same period last year, while underlying diluted EPS adjusted
for write-offs increased by 30%.
Our M&A and Advisory franchise delivered strong results despite the seasonal
slowdown typically seen in the third quarter, with several completed
transactions across sectors and a notable contribution from Project Finance.
Within capital markets, the IPO market remains accessible for well-positioned
issuers, and there is solid appetite for primary and secondary equity
transactions across geographies. DCM delivered another strong quarter, although
activity was below the exceptionally strong comparable period. Brokerage and
Research also made solid contributions, driven primarily by Equity Sales. This
broad-based performance once again demonstrated the strength of our diversified
Nordic platform.
During the quarter, we announced our partnership with Nordnet to establish a
jointly owned private banking company in Sweden. The new company will combine
ABGSC's personal advisory services, discretionary portfolio management and
institutional research with Nordnet's digital platform, broad product offering
and customer reach. The response has been very positive and reinforces our
confidence in the strength of the combination.
The Board also appointed Sverre Tyrhaug as the new CEO of ABGSC. Sverre will
assume the role during the fourth quarter. Until then, my full focus remains on
leading ABGSC and ensuring a smooth transition.
Looking ahead, we enter the fourth quarter with a solid pipeline across products
and geographies, supported by high levels of client activity. Our focus is on
converting these opportunities while continuing to strengthen our market
position.

Western Bulk declares a dividend for Q3 2026 of NOK 1,39 per share, totaling USD 4.9 million
category: ADDITIONAL REGULATED INFORMATION REQUIRED TO BE DISCLOSED UNDER THE LAWS OF A MEMBER STATE
body:
Western Bulk (ticker: WEST) used the first half of the year to build length and invest in positioning vessels into higher paying regions. This resulted in a solid third quarter result and positive net earnings year to date.
The dry bulk market remained strong through Q3, led by Capesize earnings at their highest level since 2021 on the back of record high iron ore and bauxite exports out of the Atlantic basin. This strength has filtered down to the Panamax segment, which has also been supported by continued healthy coal and grain exports, while slow steaming has reduced effective fleet supply. Geared vessel charter rates remained strong throughout the quarter, supported by longer port stays and changes in global trade flows increasing average voyage durations.
"There is a very positive momentum in the organization and we expect the results to keep strengthening throughout the year," says Torbjørn Gjervik, CEO of Western Bulk.
The Board of Directors hereby declares a dividend of NOK 1,39 per share, equivalent to approximately USD 4.9 million in total. The dividend is resolved pursuant to the authorization granted by the annual general meeting on 10 April 2026 and is based on Western Bulk's unaudited quarterly management accounts. It is in line with the company's dividend policy of paying out up to 80% of net profit in quarterly dividend payments, subject to sufficient free liquidity and working capital. The shares will trade ex-dividend on 15 October 2026, the record date is 16 October 2026, and payment will be made on or about 26 October 2026.

title: Moreld ASA: Moreld Apply awarded framework agreement with the Norwegian Defence Materiel Agency
body:
STAVANGER, October 14, 2026: Moreld Apply, part of Moreld, has been awarded a
framework agreement with the Norwegian Defence Materiel Agency
(Forsvarsmateriell) for the provision of maintenance and engineering services
for vessels operated by the Norwegian Armed Forces.
The scope includes project management, engineering services, and technical
deliveries related to maintenance, repair and upgrades of vessels and
associated systems. The agreement covers services across the Norwegian Armed
Forces' maritime assets, including surface vessels, submarines and other
vessels and systems.
Moreld Apply is one of three suppliers awarded parallel framework agreements.
The agreement has an initial term of four years, with options for an
additional three years, giving a potential total duration of up to seven
years. Work under the agreement is scheduled to commence in the fourth quarter
of 2026.
The contract's value will be determined by the volume of work performed over
the next years, and Moreld defines the contract as sizeable.
*Moreld defines a sizeable contract as between NOK 100 million and NOK 500
million in expected value.

title: Ny rente
Veidekke: Signerte ny kontrakt på NTNU Campussamling
body:
Veidekke har signert gjennomføringsavtalen med Statsbygg for byggingen av
prosjektet "Resonans" (P4 Musikk) ved NTNU Campussamling i Trondheim. Kontrakten
har en verdi på cirka 520 millioner kroner, eksklusive merverdiavgift.
Prosjektet gjennomføres som en såkalt IPL-avtale (integrert prosjektleveranse)
mellom byggherre Statsbygg, Veidekke og Norconsult, og dermed går prosjektet nå
fra utviklingsfase til gjennomføringsfase.
- Vi er svært fornøyde med å kunne signere denne avtalen med Statsbygg. Det har
vært en veldig god prosess mellom alle involverte parter frem mot denne
milepælen, og jeg er stolt over å kunne inngå den andre kontrakten i forbindelse
med NTNU Campussamling. Sammen med Statsbygg og Norconsult har vi arbeidet
målrettet for å utvikle et prosjekt som skaper størst mulig verdi for både NTNU
og samfunnet, sier Torgeir Loholt Wiig, direktør Bygg Trøndelag i Veidekke.
Moderne undervisningsbygg
Gjennomføringsavtalen markerer overgangen fra samspills- og utviklingsfasen til
bygging.Gjennom første samspillfase har partene arbeidet med optimalisering,
kostnadsstyring og prosjektering av løsninger for bygget.
- Vi gleder oss nå til å starte arbeidene på byggeplassen. Dette er et spennende
og viktig prosjekt i Trondheim som vi er stolte av å være med på å realisere,
sier konserndirektør Hans Olav Sørlie i Veidekke Bygg.
Campus P4 Musikk skal bli et nytt og moderne undervisningsbygg for Institutt for
musikkvitenskap ved NTNU. Bygget vil blant annet romme undervisningslokaler,
øvingsrom, lydstudioer, fremføringssaler og arbeidsplasser, og er utviklet med
høye krav til akustikk, funksjonalitet og kvalitet for å møte behovene til både
studenter og ansatte.
Prosjektet har et bruttoareal på 8.956 kvadratmeter, og blir på fem etasjer,
inkludert kjeller. Bygget får et bæresystem i plasstøpt betong, med komplekse og
omfattende lyd- og akustikkonstruksjoner. "Resonans" er tegnet av
Norconsult/Nordic Office of Architecture og får en teglsteinsfasade med et
særpreget uttrykk.
- Viktig milepæl
Bygget blir liggende i Høyskoleveien mellom Studentersamfundet og NTNUs
hovedbygning, og blir et sentralt element i NTNU Campussamling.
- Signeringen er en ny og viktig milepæl for NTNU Campussamling. Nå går vi fra
planlegging til gjennomføring og tar et stort steg nærmere et nytt bygg som skal
samle musikkmiljøene ved NTNU på ett sted. Med dette får NTNU et flott musikkhus
som gir gode rammer for en musikkutdanning i verdensklasse i mange år fremover,
sier Johan Arnt Vatnan, prosjektdirektør for NTNU Campussamling i Statsbygg.
Gjennom IPL-kontrakten har Statsbygg, Veidekke og Norconsult etablert én felles
prosjektorganisasjon, hvor byggherre, entreprenør og rådgiver deler ansvar for å
utvikle og realisere prosjektet.
Byggestart blir i oktober 2026 og bygget er planlagt ferdigstilt i juli 2029.
Kontrakten inngår i Veidekkes ordrereserve for tredje kvartal 2026.
Les mer om prosjektet her: https://www.statsbygg.no/byggeprosjekter/ntnu

title: Veidekke: Signs New Contract for NTNU Campus Development Project
body:
Veidekke has signed the execution agreement with Statsbygg for the construction
of the project "Resonans" (P4 Music) as part of the NTNU Campus Development
project in Trondheim. The contract is valued at approximately NOK 520 million,
excluding VAT.
The project is being delivered through an IPL contract (Integrated Project
Delivery) between the client Statsbygg, Veidekke and Norconsult. With the
signing of the agreement, the project now moves from the development phase into
the execution phase.
"We are very pleased to sign this agreement with Statsbygg. It has been an
excellent process involving all parties leading up to this milestone, and I am
proud to enter into our second contract related to the NTNU Campus Development
project. Together with Statsbygg and Norconsult, we have worked purposefully to
develop a project that creates the greatest possible value for both NTNU and the
society," says Torgeir Loholt Wiig, Regional Director Bygg Trondheim at
Veidekke.
Modern Educational Facility
The execution agreement marks the transition from the collaborative development
phase to construction. During the initial collaboration phase, the parties have
worked on optimization, cost management and the design of solutions for the
building.
"We are looking forward to starting work on site. This is an exciting and
important project in Trondheim, and we are proud to be part of bringing it to
life," says Hans Olav Sørlie, Executive Vice President, Building Construction
Norway at Veidekke.
Campus P4 Music will become a new and modern educational facility for NTNU's
Department of Musicology. The building will include classrooms, rehearsal rooms,
recording studios, performance halls and workplaces. It has been developed with
stringent requirements for acoustics, functionality and quality to meet the
needs of both students and staff.
The project comprises 8,956 square metres of gross floor area and will consist
of five floors, including a basement level. The building will feature an in-situ
cast concrete structural system and complex, extensive acoustic and sound
insulation solutions. "Resonans" has been designed by Norconsult/Nordic Office
of Architecture and will feature a distinctive brick façade.
An Important Milestone
The building will be located on Høyskoleveien between Studentersamfundet and
NTNU's Main Building, making it a central element of the NTNU Campus Development
project.
"The signing marks another important milestone for the NTNU Campus Development
project. We are now moving from planning to execution and taking a major step
closer to a new building that will bring NTNU's music communities together in
one location. This will provide NTNU with an outstanding music facility that
creates an excellent environment for world-class music education for many years
to come," says Johan Arnt Vatnan, Project Director for NTNU Campus Development
at Statsbygg.
Through the IPL contract, Statsbygg, Veidekke and Norconsult have established a
single integrated project organization in which the client, contractor and
consultant share responsibility for developing and delivering the project.
Construction is scheduled to commence in October 2026, with completion planned
for July 2029. The contract will be included in Veidekke's order backlog for the
third quarter of 2026.
Read more about the project here: NTNU Campus Development
Project (https://www.statsbygg.no/byggeprosjekter/ntnu-campussamling/)

BW Energy: Q3 2026 operational update
category: ADDITIONAL REGULATED INFORMATION REQUIRED TO BE DISCLOSED UNDER THE LAWS OF A MEMBER STATE
body:
BW Energy today provides preliminary operational figures for the third quarter
of 2026. Financial results will be published on 29 October 2026.
Net production attributable to BW Energy was 2.0 million barrels of oil
(mmbbls) in the third quarter of 2026, equivalent to 21.5 thousand barrels of
oil per day (kbopd), from the Dussafu licence in Gabon (73.5% working
interest) and the Golfinho field in Brazil (100% working interest). Net sales
were 1.1 mmbbls, with few liftings on Dussafu and none from Golfinho in the
quarter. As a result, inventory increased to 1.0 mmbbls at quarter-end, and
these volumes will be sold in the coming quarters.
Dussafu production was affected by the electrical submersible pump (ESP) issue
as communicated with the second quarter results. The well was subsequently
confirmed to require a workover and has been shut in most of the quarter. To
carry out the workover efficiently, the planned two-week seasonal maintenance
at Dussafu was rescheduled to October and is ongoing. Golfinho production was
impacted by reduced gas lift compressor (GLC) availability for parts of the
third quarter and a pump failure in one well. Replacement of the pump is
expected later in the year.
As a result of the wells shut-in on Dussafu and Golfinho, full year 2026
production is expected at approximately 23 kbopd, compared with the lower end
of 24-27 kbopd as indicated with the second quarter results.

About BW Energy:
BW Energy is a fast-growing independent oil and gas company creating value
through low-risk, phased developments of proven offshore reservoirs,
leveraging existing infrastructure and capital-efficient execution. The
company owns and operates production, development and exploration assets in
Gabon, Brazil and Namibia. Total net 2P reserves exceed 240 million barrels of
oil equivalent, with a further 390 million barrels classified as 2C resources,
providing a strong foundation to organically increase production from around
30 kbopd in 2025 to over 100 kbopd in 2028.

19 October 2026 - Svensk Sjöentreprenad i Malmö AB ("SSE"), a part of Marcon-Gruppen i Sverige AB ("Marcon"), a wholly owned subsidiary of Endúr ASA ("Endúr"), has been awarded a contract for the The Swedish Maritime Administration (Sv: "Sjöfartsverket") regarding maintenance dregding in The Göta River. The contract is expected to be worth close to SEK ~100 million.
The scope of work includes the removal of approximately ~20,000 cubic meters of contaminated non-hazardous sediment, and will involve dredging, transportation and disposal. Repstad Anlegg AS ("Repstad"), another wholly owned subsidiary of Endúr, will contribute as sub-contractor on certain processes, thereby rendering this a joint Swedish-Norwegian collaborative project within Endúr's Ports & Marine business segment.
Works are expected to commence shortly, with a project period of approximately 6-9 months.

title: BW LPG Limited   Update on BW LPG s Product Services Q3 2026 Segment Performance
body:
Singapore, 19 October 2026
BW LPG Limited ("BW LPG" or the "Company", OSE ticker code: "BWLPG.OL", NYSE
ticker code: "BWLP") today provides an update on its Product Services' ("BW
Product Services") Q3 2026 segment performance.
Q3 2026 highlights:
* Gross trading result: US$164 million
* This includes:
 * Realised trading result of US$146 million
 * Positive unrealised mark-to-market movement of US$18 million
* Net profit after general and administrative expenses and income taxes:
 US$118 million
* Average Value-At-Risk (VaR): US$18 million
* The trading result will form part of the BW LPG Q3 2026 results, which will
 be released on 24 November 2026
Performance overview:
For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, BW Product Services achieved a
realised trading result of US$146 million from our portfolio of cargo, freight
and hedging transactions. After accounting for the positive unrealised
mark-to-market movement of US$18 million from our open cargo contracts and
hedging transactions, BW Product Services reported a gross trading result of
approximately US$164 million for the quarter.
After general and administrative expenses and income taxes, the estimated net
profit was approximately US$118 million for the quarter.
The average Value-At-Risk (VaR) for Q3 was approximately US$18 million,
reflecting a sustained period of heightened market volatility across our core
product exposures.
Says Kristian Sørensen, Chief Executive Officer, "Despite continued
geopolitical uncertainty and volatile LPG market conditions, BW Product
Services delivered a strong result in Q3. This brings the year-to-date Q3
realised trading result to approximately US$263 million. BW Product Services
is well positioned to continue capitalising on the current market, thanks to
the active risk management."
For further information, please contact:
Kristian Sørensen, Chief Executive Officer
Samantha Xu, Chief Financial Officer
E-mail: investor.relations@bwlpg.com
About BW LPG
BW LPG is the world's leading owner and operator of LPG vessels, with a fleet
of about 50 Very Large Gas Carriers (VLGCs) and Large Gas Carriers (LGCs),
including 20 vessels powered by LPG dual-fuel propulsion technology. Building
on over five decades of LPG shipping experience, the company is strengthened
by an in-house LPG trading division and the commercial expertise to explore
investments in value chain assets. Together, these capabilities enable BW LPG
to provide trusted and reliable services for sourcing and delivering LPG to
customers worldwide. Delivering energy for a better world -- more information
about BW LPG can be found at www.bwlpg.com.
BW LPG is associated with BW Group, a leading global energy and maritime
company involved in shipping, deepwater oil & gas production, renewable energy
and digital infrastructure. BW controls a fleet of over 400 vessels
transporting oil, gas and dry commodities. In the infrastructure space, the
group operates in wind, batteries, water, subsea cable networks and data
centres. www.bw-group.com

title: Veidekke: Contracting markets lifted by residential projects and public buildings
body:
Veidekke expects production in the Scandinavian contracting markets to rise by
7% in 2026 and 3% in 2027, following a 6% drop in 2025. The market as a whole is
expected to level off by 2028.
The outlook for the residential market varies across Scandinavia. Despite signs
of general improvement following several weak years, residential production is
forecast to continue declining in Norway. While demand may eventually be boosted
by increased purchasing power, rising interest rates and a large stock of unsold
residential units are delaying recovery in the Norwegian market.
Public buildings are among the segments experiencing the strongest upswing.
Order intakes are up significantly in Norway and Sweden, driven particularly by
demand for hospitals, cultural buildings and sports facilities. In the
commercial buildings sector, the picture is more nuanced: while there is growth
in Norway, the trend in Sweden has been weaker, particularly in the industrial
and logistics segments.
The civil engineering market is predicted to remain strong throughout the
forecast period. Transport infrastructure, energy, water supply and sewerage are
key drivers, with particularly strong growth anticipated in Sweden. Continued
growth is also expected in the Norwegian market, albeit at a more moderate pace.
"The upturn is both somewhat stronger and somewhat broader than we anticipated
in the spring. The public buildings sector is on the up, and major investments
in transport infrastructure, energy, water supply and sewerage are keeping
activity levels buoyant. Residential markets are showing signs of improvement in
several geographies, but Norway is lagging overall and is expected to experience
falling activity levels for some time to come. The outlook for different
countries and market segments therefore varies considerably," says Kristoffer
Eide Hoen, Director of Insight and Analysis at Veidekke.
Production growth in 2026 is estimated at 7% in Norway, 9% in Sweden and 6% in
Denmark. The forecast growth figures for 2027 are 3%, 4% and 2%, respectively.
Compared to Veidekke's spring forecast, the growth estimates for Scandinavia
have been raised from 6% to 7% for 2026 and from 1% to 3% for 2027.
The market update is available on the Veidekke website, under About us |
Investor relations | Reports and presentations | Market updates.
For further information, please contact:
Kristoffer Eide Hoen, Head of Insight and Analysis at Veidekke ASA Tel. +47 976
75 434 | Kristoffer.Eide.Hoen@veidekke.no
Veidekke is one of Scandinavia's largest contractors. In addition to undertaking
all types of building and civil engineering assignments, the group also
maintains roads and produces asphalt and aggregates. Veidekke emphasises
stakeholder involvement and local experience. Its annual turnover is
approximately NOK 43 billion, and half of its 8,000 employees own shares in the
company. Veidekke is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange and has posted a profit
every year since its inception in 1936.
