title: Axactor ASA announces third quarter financial results
body:
(Oslo, 29 October 2026) Axactor ASA announces third quarter financial results
Axactor continued the transformation journey during the third quarter. After successfully deleveraging the company through a EUR ~215m equity issue and EUR 100m portfolio sale in the second quarter, the ACR04 bond was refinanced towards the end of this quarter at significantly tighter margins securing a more competitive platform going forwards. Consequently, interest expenses on borrowings fell to EUR 15m in the quarter, a reduction of 17% compared with the third quarter of 2025. A further reduction in interest expenses is expected in the fourth quarter. 
Key figures Q3 2026 (Q3 2025 in brackets)*
- NPL collection performance of 104% (98%)
- Gross revenue of EUR 74m (EUR 78m) 
- Total revenue of EUR 57m (EUR 62m) 
- EBITDA of EUR 26m (EUR 33m) 
- Cash EBITDA of EUR 44m (EUR 49m) 
- NPL investments of EUR 20m (EUR 2m)
"I am pleased to see that we are developing according to the plan and delivering on key value drivers with regards to deleveraging and refinancing", says Johnny Tsolis, CEO of Axactor.
"Our new co-investment partnership with Fortress is off to a good start and we acquired the first two portfolios through our co-investment vehicle during the quarter. The pipeline for NPL portfolios is historically large, but we also experience a highly competitive market. Increased investments is one of the most important value drivers for Axactor going forwards as it will add significant scale effects. Still, we maintain a strong investment discipline to secure healthy IRR levels", concludes Tsolis.

title: Pareto Bank ASA Delårsrapport 3. kvartal 2026
body:
Pareto Bank fikk i tredje kvartal 2026 et resultat etter skatt på kr 27,7 mill. (kr 176,8 mill. i tredje kvartal 2025). Aksjonærenes andel av resultatet var kr 14,5 mill. (kr 163,7 mill.). Resultatet tilsvarte en egenkapitalavkastning etter skatt på 1,2 % (13,0 %) og et resultat per aksje på kr 0,19 (kr 2,13).
Netto renteinntekter utgjorde kr 285,2 mill. (kr 304,4 mill.), og var kr 19,3 mill. lavere enn samme periode året før. Reduksjonen i netto renteinntekter skyldtes hovedsakelig lavere utlånsvolum og aktivitetsdrevne gebyrer. Netto rentemargin økte fra 4,4 % i tredje kvartal i fjor til 4,8 % som følge av balansetilpasninger. Verdier på obligasjoner i likviditetsporteføljen sank i kvartalet med kr 4,8 mill. Totalt var tap på finansielle instrumenter vurdert til virkelig verdi kr 15,4 mill. i tredje kvartal mot et tap på kr 6,5 mill. i tredje kvartal 2025. Netto provisjonsinntekter fra banktjenester og garantier utgjorde kr 2,8 mill. (kr 3,4 mill.). Samlede inntekter ble kr 279,0 mill. (kr 305,6 mill.).
Banken drives med en vedvarende høy operasjonell effektivitet. Driftskostnader i kvartalet var kr 50,7 mill. (kr 59,2 mill.). Dette ga en kostnadsprosent på 18,2 % (19,4 %). Ingen avsetning til variabel godtgjørelse reduserte lønnskostnadene til kr 29,8 mill., hvilket tilsvarte en nedgang på kr 7,3 mill. fra fjoråret til tross for flere ansatte. I tilsvarende periode i fjor ble det satt av kr 8,8 mill. til variabel godtgjørelse.
Netto utlån til kunder endte på kr 17.934 mill. (kr 18.983 mill.), hvilket tilsvarte en reduksjon i utlån på kr 1.472 mill. fra utgangen av forrige kvartal. Gjennomsnittlig utlån var 3,4 % lavere i tredje kvartal enn i andre kvartal. Innskudd fra kunder utgjorde kr 10.259 mill. (kr 13.227 mill.), hvilket tilsvarte en reduksjon fra forrige kvartal på kr 599 mill. Bankens forvaltningskapital var ved kvartalsskiftet kr 22,8 milliarder (kr 26,8 milliarder).
Nedskrivinger og tap på utlån utgjorde kr 195,8 mill. (kr 15,1 mill.) i tredje kvartal. Individuelle nedskrivninger økte med netto kr 130,2 mill. som følge av vedvarende utfordringer for flere engasjementer innenfor boligutvikling. Økt andel kreditter med individuell vurdering, noe lavere makroøkonomiske avsetninger samt reduksjon i kreditteksponering medførte kr 68,6 mill. i lavere modellbaserte nedskrivninger. Det ble i tillegg konstatert kr 134,3 mill. i tap i tredje kvartal, mot kr. 8,5 mill. i tredje kvartal i fjor. Konstateringene knyttet seg til flere engasjementer innen boligutvikling og ett bedriftsengasjement.
Ren kjernekapitaldekning utgjorde 21,0 % (21,3 %) mot bankens langsiktige kapitalmål på minst 15,7 %. Uvektet kjernekapitalandel utgjorde 20,4 % (18,0 %).
Utlånsvolumene utviklet seg svakere enn ventet i tredje kvartal og endte i sum ned 7,6 %. Innen eiendomsutvikling i Norge er det stadig lavere kredittetterspørsel og Pareto Bank avslår flere søknader. Innen bedrifts- og skipsfinansiering var det prosesser som ikke materialiserte seg som ventet, samt at den norske kronen har styrket seg. For fjerde kvartal forventes det i sum en ytterligere reduksjon i utlånsvolumene drevet av videre nedgang på eiendomsfinansiering i Norge og flat utvikling på bedrifts- og skipsfinansiering. I Sverige forventes det videre vekst.
Nyboligmarkedet i Norge forblir meget svakt. Risikoen er fortsatt høy i deler av bankens boligutviklingsportefølje, og selv om dette er reflektert i bankens tapsavsetninger er utfallsrommet for utviklingen i kredittkvalitet relativt stort også i de kommende kvartalene. Arbeidet med å avslutte prosjekter og begrense tap fortsetter med høyeste prioritet, men tar tid både som følge av prosjektspesifikke forhold og som følge av det svake salgsmarkedet.
Gjennom underliggende god lønnsomhet har Pareto Bank en sterk tapsabsorberende evne. Bankens langsiktige lønnsomhetsambisjon står fast på 15 %. Det samme gjør bankens utbyttepolitikk om en utdeling på 50 % eller mer årlig.

title: KONGSBERG secures US government contract for underwater capabilities
body:
Kongsberg Gruppen ASA ('KONGSBERG') has been awarded a major contract modification by the Department of War Innovation Unit (DIU) for autonomous underwater capabilities.
The modification to the Prototype Other Transaction Agreement, valued at USD 54 million, is primarily driven by the delivery of a broad range of autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs), alongside associated underwater capability components.
Strengthening long-standing U.S. collaboration
KONGSBERG CEO Eirik Lie said the contract reflected continued trust in the company's underwater technology and delivery capabilities.
"This contract continues our collaboration with DIU and the US Navy and reflects confidence in KONGSBERG's autonomous underwater technology. We remain focused on delivering reliable systems for demanding operational environments. It also demonstrates the value of our dual-use portfolio in delivering defence capabilities and further strengthens our position as a technology and defence company," said Lie.
KONGSBERG has more than 30 years of proven experience in autonomous underwater vehicles. The company continues to develop and deliver trusted large AUV systems for defence and commercial customers worldwide.
Contracts worth NOK 1.7 billion
Camilla Kiss, Executive Vice President, KONGSBERG, and President of the Discovery division, said the award reflected continued demand for autonomous underwater systems across defence and commercial markets.
"Autonomous underwater systems are a core part of KONGSBERG's technology portfolio. So far in 2026, we have signed AUV contracts worth a total of NOK 1.7 billion across all markets. This progress supports our strategic ambition to grow in undersea warfare and strengthens the foundation for continued development," said Kiss.
KONGSBERG has worked in the undersea domain for 30 years, developing defence missionised, robust systems with highly trusted autonomous capabilities. According to Kiss the pace of technological change has never been faster. 
"Advances in artificial intelligence, edge processing and autonomy are enabling platforms to undertake increasingly complex missions with greater persistence and operational effectiveness. We are at the forefront of this development," she said.
KONGSBERG (OSE ticker: KOG) is an international technology and defence company that delivers critical products and solutions in defence, security and surveillance on land, underwater and in space. KONGSBERG has approximately 7 800 employees in 20 countries and had a total revenue of NOK 32.8 billion in 2025.

title: KONGSBERG tildelt amerikansk kontrakt for autonome undervannskapasiteter
body:
Kongsberg Gruppen ASA ('KONGSBERG') har blitt tildelt en betydelig kontraktsutvidelse fra det amerikanske forsvarsdepartementets Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) for autonome undervannskapasiteter.
Utvidelsen av avtalen (Prototype Other Transaction Agreement), med en verdi på USD 54 millioner, er i hovedsak knyttet til levering av et bredt spekter av autonome undervannsfarkoster (AUV), samt tilhørende komponenter for undervannskapasiteter.
Styrker et langvarig samarbeid med USA
Konsernsjef i KONGSBERG, Eirik Lie, sier kontrakten gjenspeiler tilliten til selskapets undervannsteknologi og leveranseevne.
- Denne kontrakten viderefører vårt samarbeid med DIU og U.S. Navy, og gjenspeiler tilliten til KONGSBERGs autonome undervannsteknologi. Vi er fokusert på å levere pålitelige systemer for krevende operative miljøer. Kontrakten demonstrerer også verdien av vår dual-use-portefølje ved å levere forsvarskapasiteter, samtidig som den styrker vår posisjon som teknologi- og forsvarsselskap, sier Lie.
KONGSBERG har mer enn 30 års dokumentert erfaring med autonome undervannsfarkoster. Selskapet fortsetter å utvikle og levere store, pålitelige AUV-systemer til forsvars- og kommersielle kunder over hele verden.
Kontrakter verdt 1,7 milliarder kroner
Camilla Kiss, Executive Vice President i KONGSBERG og leder for Discovery-divisjonen, sier tildelingen reflekterer den vedvarende etterspørselen etter autonome undervannssystemer innen både forsvars- og kommersielle markeder.
- Autonome undervannssystemer er en kjernekomponent i KONGSBERGs teknologiportefølje. Så langt i 2026 har vi inngått AUV-kontrakter til en samlet verdi av 1,7 milliarder kroner på tvers av alle markeder. Denne utviklingen støtter vår strategiske ambisjon om vekst innen undervannskrigføring og styrker grunnlaget for videre utvikling, sier Kiss.
KONGSBERG har arbeidet innen undervannsområdet i 30 år, og utviklet robuste, spesialiserte forsvarssystemer med svært pålitelige autonome funksjoner. Ifølge Kiss har tempoet i den teknologiske utviklingen aldri vært høyere.
- Fremskritt innen kunstig intelligens, edge processing og autonomi gjør det mulig for plattformer å utføre stadig mer komplekse oppdrag med større utholdenhet og operativ effekt. Vi er helt i front av denne utviklingen, sier hun.
Kongsberg Gruppen (OSE-ticker: KOG) er et internasjonalt teknologi- og forsvarsselskap som leverer kritiske produkter og løsninger innen forsvar, sikkerhet og overvåking på land, under vann og i rommet. KONGSBERG har ca. 7 800 medarbeidere i 20 land, og hadde en samlet omsetning på 32,8 milliarder kroner i 2025.

title: Sparebanken Møre strengthening its position as market leader
body:
Sparebanken Møre has delivered strong lending growth in both the retail and corporate markets, while expenses remain stable and losses are low.
Profit after tax for the third quarter amounted to NOK 262 million, NOK 4 million higher than for the same quarter last year. The return on equity was 12.0 per cent, compared with 12.2 per cent for the same period in 2025.
Growth in both customer segments
Sparebanken Møre's corporate lending has increased by 9.4 per cent in the past 12 months, while retail lending has increased by 5.3 per cent. In total, lending grew by 6.7 per cent, well above market growth. Both new and existing customers are contributing to the growth.
"We continue to take market share in Nordvestlandet in a highly competitive market. Professional advisors who understand their customers and local business community are a key factor behind the growth. At the same time, digital solutions are freeing up time that we can then spend advising and following up customers. We're also seeing good growth outside the region," says Trond Lars Nydal, CEO of Sparebanken Møre.
A strong housing market
The housing market in Møre og Romsdal is performing well, and prices have risen sharply in 2026. However, compared with other parts of the country, prices remain moderate and well below the national average.
"Residential mortgage demand remains strong despite the rate hike, and the number of customers asking for interest-only periods or payment relief remains low. At the same time, we're monitoring developments closely and prepared for the fact that our customers' situations could change," says Nydal.
Stable expenses and low losses
Expenses remain stable and largely unchanged from last year, and losses are low. Bankruptcy figures for Møre og Romsdal have generally mirrored national trends, and the number of bankruptcies is on a downwards trend. Recognised losses amounted to NOK 11 million for the third quarter, compared with NOK 24 million for the same quarter of 2025.
"Expenses were on a par with previous quarters. The fact that we can generate growth without increasing our cost base tells us that we can operate a more efficient bank. Furthermore, we can also see that losses are stable and low," says Nydal.
Good levels of activity in our region, Nordvestlandet
The uncertainty in the global economy is considerable, but the Norwegian economy has so far proven resilient. Activity in Nordvestlandet remains strong, particularly in certain sectors of industry and the maritime sector. At the same time, higher interest rates mean that the market conditions for industries such as construction and civil engineering remain challenging. Nonetheless, overall, our region is expected to see a good level of activity going forward.

title: Sparebanken Møre styrker posisjonen som markedsleder
body:
Sparebanken Møre leverer sterk utlånsvekst i både person- og næringslivsmarkedet, samtidig som kostnadene er stabile og tapene lave.
I tredje kvartal ble resultatet etter skatt 262 mill. kroner, 4 mill. kroner høyere enn i samme kvartal i fjor. Egenkapitalavkastningen landet på 12,0 prosent, mot 12,2 prosent i samme periode i 2025.
Vokser i begge kundemarkeder
Sparebanken Møres utlån til næringslivet har økt med 9,4 prosent de siste 12 månedene, mens utlån til personkunder har økt med 5,3 prosent. Samlet utlånsvekst er på 6,7 prosent, noe som ligger godt over markedsveksten. Både nye og eksisterende kunder bidrar til økningen.
- Vi fortsetter å ta markedsandeler på Nordvestlandet i et marked med sterk konkurranse. Dyktige rådgivere som kjenner kundene og det lokale næringslivet, er en viktig årsak til veksten. Samtidig frigir digitale løsninger tid som vi kan bruke på rådgivning og oppfølging av kundene. Vi opplever også god vekst utenfor regionen, sier Trond Lars Nydal, adm. direktør i Sparebanken Møre.
Et solid boligmarked
Det er god utvikling i boligmarkedet i Møre og Romsdal, og prisutviklingen i 2026 har vært sterk. Sammenlignet med andre deler av landet er prisnivået likevel fortsatt moderat og godt under landsgjennomsnittet.
- Etterspørselen etter boliglån er god til tross for rentehevingen, og antall kunder som ber om avdragsfrihet eller betalingslettelser holder seg på et lavt nivå. Samtidig er vi tett på og forberedt på at kundenes situasjon kan endre seg, sier Nydal.
Stabile kostnader og lave tap
Kostnadsnivået er stabilt og om lag uendret fra fjoråret, og tapene er lave. Konkurstallene i Møre og Romsdal følger i all hovedsak de nasjonale svingningene, og antall konkurser viser en fallende trend. I tredje kvartal ble det bokført tap på 11 mill. kroner mot 24 mill. kroner i samme kvartal i 2025.
- Kostnadene ligger på samme nivå som i de foregående kvartalene. At vi klarer å skape vekst uten å øke kostnadsbasen, forteller oss at vi klarer å drive en mer effektiv bank. Videre ser vi også at tapene holder seg på et lavt nivå, sier Nydal.
God aktivitet på Nordvestlandet
Usikkerheten i internasjonal økonomi er stor, men norsk økonomi har så langt vist seg å være robust. På Nordvestlandet er aktiviteten fortsatt god, særlig innen deler av industrien og den maritime næringen. Høyere rentenivå gjør samtidig at markedsforholdene for næringer som bygg og anlegg fortsetter å være krevende. Samlet ventes det likevel et godt aktivitetsnivå i regionen vår fremover.
Nøkkeltall - 3. kvartal 2026
- Rentenetto: 505 mill. kroner/1,80 prosent (515 mill. kroner/1,88 prosent)
- Resultat før tap: 354 mill. kroner (362 mill. kroner)
- Resultat etter skatt: 262 mill. kroner (258 mill. kroner)

title: Q3 2026: KONGSBERG delivers a strong third quarter with a record-high order backlog
category: ADDITIONAL REGULATED INFORMATION REQUIRED TO BE DISCLOSED UNDER THE LAWS OF A MEMBER STATE
body:
Kongsberg Gruppen ASA (KONGSBERG, OSE: KOG) increased its revenues by 50 per cent to NOK 11.3 billion in the third quarter. High activity levels and strong demand for the company's products and solutions contributed to both growth and a record-high order backlog. 
"At a time when European security is being challenged, our task is to strengthen defence capabilities through technology, capacity and delivery performance. We are expanding our capacity, including in Poland, to meet growing demand. Our focus now is on executing on our strong order backlog, which provides a solid foundation for continued growth," said Eirik Lie, President and CEO of KONGSBERG.
Highlights and key figures, third quarter 2026:
- Strong order intake of NOK 23.3 billion
- 50 per cent revenue growth to NOK 11.3 billion
- EBIT increased by 66 per cent to NOK 1.9 billion
- Record-high order backlog of NOK 174.2 billion
"KONGSBERG's market-leading solutions in missiles, air defence and remote weapon stations address some of the most pressing security and defence challenges facing the world today. At the same time, the underwater domain and satellite technology are becoming increasingly important to national security and resilience," said Lie.
Strong demand for KONGSBERG's technology
Demand across KONGSBERG's portfolio continued to strengthen throughout the quarter. In particular, interest remained strong for the company's missiles, air defence systems and remote weapon stations.
In July, the United States Air Force ordered additional Joint Strike Missiles (JSM) for its F-35 fleet. Later in the quarter, KONGSBERG signed a framework agreement with the US Marine Corps covering production and sustainment support for the Naval Strike Missile (NSM). In October, Denmark, as the seventh nation, announced its intention to procure the JSM for its F-35 fighter aircraft.
KONGSBERG also signed several major air defence contracts. Among these was a NOK 10 billion agreement with Belgium for NASAMS. Belgium thereby became the 18th nation to have ordered NASAMS.
In addition, KONGSBERG signed a contract to deliver remote weapon stations for the Canadian Army's Armoured Combat Support Vehicle programme. The weapon stations are a key component of the company's counter-drone capabilities.
Strengthening the technology portfolio
The underwater domain is becoming increasingly important for national security, the protection of critical infrastructure, and maritime domain awareness. With extensive expertise in underwater sensor technologies and autonomous underwater systems, KONGSBERG is strongly positioned to meet growing demand in this expanding market.
During the third quarter, the U.S. government awarded KONGSBERG a USD 54 million contract related to autonomous underwater capabilities. U.S. authorities also approved KONGSBERG's acquisition of Sonatech during the quarter. The acquisition expands the company's expertise in underwater acoustics and strengthens its position in the U.S. market.
KONGSBERG's acquisition of Zone 5 Technologies in the second quarter of 2026 expanded the company's missile portfolio with solutions that can be produced cost-effectively at scale. During the third quarter, Zone 5 was selected for a U.S. Navy program valued at USD 65 million, demonstrating the relevance of Zone 5's technology in a market characterised by growing demand.
Record-high order backlog provides strong visibility
Order intake in the third quarter amounted to NOK 23.3 billion, compared with NOK 9.5 billion in the corresponding quarter last year. This resulted in a book-to-bill ratio of 2.06.
At the end of the third quarter of 2026, the KONGSBERG's order backlog stood at NOK 174.2 billion, an increase of NOK 16.7 billion during the quarter. Year-to-date in 2026, the company has achieved an order intake of NOK 67 billion. The order backlog extends over many years and provides predictability for future development.
"The current security environment requires industry to deliver rapidly, reliably and at scale. With a record order backlog and continued strong demand, we are well positioned to meet the needs of our customers and allies. Together with our suppliers, we have the capacity required to strengthen defence capabilities, enhance preparedness and ensure that we are ready to meet tomorrow's needs," said Lie.
KONGSBERG (OSE ticker: KOG) is an international technology and defence company that delivers critical products and solutions in defence, security and surveillance on land, underwater and in space. KONGSBERG has approximately 7 800 employees in 20 countries and had a total revenue of NOK 32.8 billion in 2025.

title: Q3 2026: KONGSBERG leverer et sterkt tredje kvartal med en rekordhøy ordrereserve
category: ADDITIONAL REGULATED INFORMATION REQUIRED TO BE DISCLOSED UNDER THE LAWS OF A MEMBER STATE
body:
Kongsberg Gruppen ASA (KONGSBERG, OSE:KOG) økte inntektene med 50 prosent til 11,3 milliarder kroner i tredje kvartal. Høy aktivitet og sterk etterspørsel etter selskapets produkter og løsninger bidro til både vekst og en rekordhøy ordrereserve. 
- I en tid der europeisk sikkerhet utfordres, er vår oppgave å styrke forsvarsevnen gjennom teknologi, kapasitet og leveranseevne. Vi bygger ut kapasiteten, blant annet i Polen, for å møte den økte etterspørselen. Nå handler det om å levere på den sterke ordrereserven, som gir et solid grunnlag for videre vekst, sier konsernsjef Eirik Lie.
Høydepunkter og nøkkeltall, tredje kvartal 2026:
- Sterk ordreinngang på 23,3 milliarder kroner
- 50 prosent inntektsvekst til 11,3 milliarder kroner
- EBIT økte 66 prosent til 1,9 milliarder kroner
- Rekordhøy ordrereserve på 174,2 milliarder kroner
- KONGSBERGs markedsledende løsninger innen missiler, luftvern og våpenstasjoner adresserer noen av de mest sentrale sikkerhets- og forsvarsutfordringene verden står overfor i dag. Samtidig blir undervannsdomenet og satellitteknologi stadig viktigere for nasjonal sikkerhet og beredskap, sier Lie.
Sterk etterspørsel etter KONGSBERGs teknologi
Etterspørselen etter KONGSBERGs portefølje fortsatte å styrke seg øke gjennom kvartalet. Særlig var interessen høy for selskapets missiler, luftvernsystemer og fjernstyrte våpenstasjoner.
I juli bestilte det amerikanske luftforsvaret ytterligere Joint Strike Missile (JSM) til sin F-35-flåte. Senere i kvartalet signerte KONGSBERG en rammeavtale med US Marine Corps om produksjons- og vedlikeholdsstøtte til Naval Strike Missile. I oktober kunngjorde Danmark, som den syvende nasjonen, sin intensjon om å anskaffe JSM til sine F-35-kampfly.
KONGSBERG signerte også flere større kontrakter innen luftvern. Blant disse var en avtale med Belgia om NASAMS til en verdi av 10 milliarder kroner. Belgia ble dermed det 18. landet som har bestilt NASAMS..
I tillegg signerte KONGSBERG en kontrakt om levering av fjernstyrte våpenstasjoner til den canadiske hærens pansrede støttekjøretøy. Våpenstasjonene er en sentral del av selskapets anti-droneløsninger.
Styrker teknologiporteføljen
Undervannsdomenet blir stadig viktigere for nasjonal sikkerhet, beskyttelse av kritisk infrastruktur og maritim situasjonsforståelse. Med lang erfaring innen undervannssensorikk og autonome undervannssystemer er KONGSBERG godt posisjonert i et marked med voksende etterspørsel.
I tredje kvartal tildelte amerikanske myndigheter KONGSBERG en kontrakt verdt USD 54 millioner knyttet til autonome undervannskapasiteter. Amerikanske myndigheter godkjente også KONGSBERGs oppkjøp av Sonatech i kvartalet. Oppkjøpet utvider selskapets kompetanse innen undervannsakustikk og styrker posisjonen i det amerikanske markedet.
KONGSBERGs oppkjøp av Zone 5 Technologies i andre kvartal 2026 utvidet selskapets missilportefølje med løsninger som kan produseres kostnadseffektivt i stor skala. I løpet av tredje kvartal ble Zone 5 valgt til et program for U.S. Navy med en verdi på USD 65 millioner, noe som understreker relevansen av selskapets teknologi i et marked preget av økende etterspørsel.
Rekordhøy ordrereserve gir god forutsigbarhet
Ordreinngangen i tredje kvartal ble 23,3 milliarder kroner, mot 9,5 milliarder kroner i samme kvartal i fjor. Dette ga en book-to-bill-ratio på 2,06.
Ved utgangen av tredje kvartal 2026 var KONGSBERGs ordrereserve 174,2 milliarder kroner, en økning på 16,7 milliarder kroner i kvartalet. I 2026 har selskapet hatt en ordreinngang på 67 milliarder kroner. Ordrereserven strekker seg over mange år og gir forutsigbarhet for den videre utviklingen.
- Den sikkerhetspolitiske situasjonen krever at industrien evner å levere raskt, pålitelig og i stor skala. Med en rekordstor ordrereserve og høy etterspørsel står vi godt rustet til å møte behovene til våre kunder og allierte. Sammen med våre leverandører har vi kapasiteten som trengs for å styrke forsvarsevnen, øke beredskapen og sikre at vi møter morgendagens behov, sier Lie.
Kongsberg Gruppen (OSE-ticker: KOG) er et internasjonalt teknologi- og forsvarsselskap som leverer kritiske produkter og løsninger innen forsvar, sikkerhet og overvåking på land, under vann og i rommet. KONGSBERG har ca. 7 800 medarbeidere i 20 land, og hadde en samlet omsetning på 32,8 milliarder kroner i 2025.

title: DNO Races Ahead on Stronger Production, Higher Prices
body:
Oslo, 29 October 2026 - DNO ASA, the Norwegian oil and gas operator, today
announced strong financial and operational results for the third quarter of
2026, driven by the resumption of Kurdistan region of Iraq production and higher
prices across the portfolio.
Net production increased 61 percent from the previous quarter to 142,800 barrels
of oil equivalent per day (boepd), of which the North Sea contributed 85,400
boepd, Kurdistan 54,900 boepd and West Africa 2,500 boepd.
Revenues of USD one billion, an all-time high, were up a third quarter-on-
quarter. Operating profit jumped 46 percent to USD 641 million, also a record
figure for the 55-year-old company, while net profit climbed 21 percent to USD
101 million.
Realized North Sea prices rose six percent to an average of USD 106.7 per barrel
of oil equivalent during the quarter. In Kurdistan, DNO received USD 38.5 per
barrel, the highest price realized since local sales commenced in 2023, with all
payments made to the Company's international bank accounts in advance of
deliveries. Prices for oil sales in Kurdistan were raised this month to USD 45
per barrel, up nearly 50 percent from sales at the start of 2026.
With 2026 maintenance largely completed, DNO expects North Sea production to
average around 86,000 boepd for the full year. In northern Iraq, DNO resumed
production at midyear from its operated Tawke license (75 percent) after a four-
month precautionary shutdown due to escalation of drone and missile attacks in
the Middle East. Gross operated production stood at 73,200 boepd in the third
quarter and is expected to average 50,000 boepd for the full year.
DNO maintained a high level of business development activity during the quarter,
including divesting its Côte d'Ivoire business, realizing an annualized return
of 24 percent on the Company's investment since entering the country in October
2022.
"DNO remains very much focused on growth but only if it meets our profitability
targets," said Executive Chairman Bijan Mossavar-Rahmani. "In our business, the
price of oil and gas is the single most important driver of profitability, but
not the only one," he said. "Obviously, price is outside our control but not so
exploration success, at which we excel, and not so capital discipline, which we
exercise with utmost rigor."
Overall, five new field developments have been delivered offshore Norway since
2025, another six are under execution and six additional projects are
approaching investment decision, all planned onstream before 2030. DNO continues
to target North Sea production of 100,000 boepd by 2030.
In Kurdistan, drilling activity also stepped up during the third quarter with a
second third-party rig deployed to take part in the eight-well drilling program
initiated shortly before yearend 2025. By far the most active operator in
Kurdistan, DNO plans to increase drilling further in 2027 and is considering
contracting a third large rig, and also drilling beyond the existing production
footprint on the license.
The Board of Directors has approved a quarterly dividend of NOK 0.375 per share,
payable in November 2026, maintaining the same level as in the previous five
quarters.
A videoconference call with executive management will follow today at 10:00
(CET). Please visit www.dno.no to access the call.

title: BW Energy: Third quarter 2026 report
body:
BW Energy delivered good progress in the third quarter of 2026, with the major
development projects advancing on schedule and within budget. The Company
extended its strong Dussafu appraisal track record with two discoveries and
made a strategic entry into Angola, adding further production and reserves in
a basin with material growth potential.
On 24 October 2026, the Prospector 5 jack-up drilling rig, owned and operated
by Borr Drilling, sank during preparations for the MaBoMo Phase 2 drilling
campaign. Alongside supporting the ongoing search and rescue efforts, the
Company is assessing the impact on the drilling schedule and the 2027
production outlook. BW Energy maintains the target of producing over 100,000
barrels per day in 2028.
HIGHLIGHTS
(Numbers in parenthesis refer to Q2 2026 unless otherwise specified)
Solid operational performance
* Q3 2026 net production of 21.5 (25.3) kbopd, equal to 2.0 (2.3) million
 barrels (mmbbls)
* Quarterly production cost[1] of USD 27.7 (24.0) per barrel
* Production in Gabon and Brazil impacted by temporary technical issues
* Inventory increase to 1.0 mmbbls at quarter-end due to timing of liftings
2028 production target maintained
* Maromba, Golfinho and Bourdon projects progressing on plan and cost
* MaBoMo appraisals add 8-9 mmbbls of recoverable volumes, supporting two
 production wells
* MaBoMo phase 2 delayed by the rig incident, schedule under assessment
* Strategic Angola entry set to add net 8 kbopd of production from Q1 2027 and
 ~19 mmbbls net 2P reserves
Financial results impacted by timing of liftings
* Q3 2026 EBITDA of USD 46.9 (140.6) million and net loss of USD 0.7 (profit
 43.9) million
* Q3 operating cash flow of negative USD 19.4 (positive 260.1) million
* Cash position of USD 200.3 (254.0) million at 30 September
* Signed USD 208 million long-term financing for the Bourdon wellhead platform
 (WHP)
* Extended USD 250 million corporate revolving credit facility (RCF) by 18
 months
2026 guidance updated
* Production: ~23 kbopd (from low end of 24-27 kbopd)
* Production cost[1]: USD 22-26 per barrel (unchanged)
* CAPEX: Suspended in light of well program rescheduling (was USD 600-650
 million)
* G&A: USD 12-14 million (unchanged)
Comment from the CEO of BW Energy, Carl K. Arnet:
"Our thoughts are with everyone affected by the Prospector 5 rig incident, the
crew and their families, friends and colleagues, and in particular those still
missing and their loved ones. At BW Energy, the safety of people will always
come first, and we are supporting the ongoing search and rescue operations in
close collaboration with the Gabonese authorities and Borr Drilling, with
valuable help from our neighbouring operators.
Production from MaBoMo has resumed, and the two discoveries made earlier in
the campaign add to the resources we plan to develop in Phase 2. The incident
affects the timing of those barrels rather than the resources themselves. We
will incorporate the remaining wells into the wider Dussafu drilling programme
and update the market on timing once the plan is in place.
Looking further ahead we maintain our production target of over 100,000
barrels per day in 2028 supported by good progress on the remaining sanctioned
high-return development projects in Brazil and Gabon, as well as our expansion
into Angola. Backed by a robust financing framework, we remain on track to
deliver strong long-term cash flow and material value creation for the BW
Energy shareholders."

report, presentation, excel data book and webcast are all available on:
www.bwenergy.no/investors/reports-and-presentations

module, available on:

About BW Energy:
BW Energy is a fast-growing independent oil and gas company creating value
through low-risk, phased developments of proven offshore reservoirs,
leveraging existing infrastructure and capital-efficient execution. The
company owns and operates production, development and exploration assets in
Gabon, Brazil and Namibia. Total net 2P reserves exceed 240 million barrels of
oil equivalent, with a further 390 million barrels classified as 2C resources,
providing a strong foundation to organically increase production from around
30 kbopd in 2025 to over 100 kbopd in 2028.

title: Europris strengthens margins and enters key season well positioned for value-focused consumers
body:
The group delivered solid gross margin in the third quarter, while the year-on
-year development in like-for-like footfall was below expectations.
Alongside the group's everyday low-price offering, seasonal ranges are important
drivers of store footfall and sales of both seasonal items and the broader
assortment. Lower footfall in the quarter largely reflected an earlier onset of
summer in the Nordics compared with last year. Adjusted for this timing effect,
the overall performance of the summer season was good and delivered according to
plan.
Customers remain price-conscious and continued to favour lower-priced items.
Europris and ÖoB are well positioned to meet these preferences, and sales of
both campaign products and private-label products continued to grow. However,
the campaign programme performed below expectations in the third quarter, and
corrective measures have been initiated.
Financial highlights - third quarter
 - Total sales amounted to NOK 3,473 million (3,528), representing a decrease
of 1.6% on a reported basis and a growth of 0.6% in constant currency
 - Like-for-like sales declined 0.1% for the Europris chain and was up 2.1% for
the ÖoB chain in local currency
 - Gross profit increased to NOK 1,459 million (1,437), with a gross margin of
42.0% (40.7%)
 - EBIT declined to NOK 244 million (256), corresponding to an EBIT margin of
7.0% (7.3%)
 - Net profit attributable to owners of the parent company amounted to NOK 129
million (154)
 - Earnings per share were NOK 0.79 (0.94)
Financial highlights - first nine months
 - Total sales amounted to NOK 10,467 million (10,268), representing a growth
of 1.9% on a reported basis and 3.1% in constant currency
 - Like-for-like sales increased 3.7% for the Europris chain and 1.7% for the
ÖoB chain in local currency
 - Gross profit increased to NOK 4,328 million (4,118), with a gross margin of
41.4% (40.1%)
 - EBIT increased to NOK 710 million (642), corresponding to an EBIT margin of
6.8% (6.2%)
 - Net profit attributable to owners of the parent company amounted to NOK 378
million (350)
 - Earnings per share were NOK 2.31 (2.14)
 - Cash flow from operating activities was a positive NOK 900 million (positive
254)
 - Net debt excluding lease liabilities amounted to NOK 1,401 million (1,795)
Comment from CEO Espen Eldal:
"This year's summer sales came early in the season and were already reflected in
the sales figures for June. Our campaigns were also not as effective as
intended. As a result, we did not attract as many customers as we had hoped in
the third quarter. At the same time, we successfully strengthened our gross
margin.
In Sweden, we have taken important new steps towards establishing ÖoB as the
natural destination for seasonal shopping. We have been following a clear three
-step plan: harmonise the concept, sharpen the seasonal focus and remodel the
stores. We are now almost halfway through the remodeling programme, and the
upcoming Christmas season will be our first real test.
Through our relentless focus on low prices, broad assortments and strong
promotional capabilities, the group is well positioned to benefit from
consumers' continued focus on price, value for money and promotions. I am
pleased that our stores are well stocked and prepared for the final and most
important quarter of the year in both Norway and Sweden."
Outlook
Higher interest rates may weigh on consumer sentiment, although consumers are
expected to benefit from real wage growth in both countries this year and next
year.
Consumers are expected to remain price-conscious, with a continued strong focus
on value for money and promotional offers. Europris and ÖoB remain well
positioned in this environment through their low-price concepts, broad
assortments and strong promotional capabilities. The group is well stocked and
prepared for the important Christmas season.
Visibility remains limited for certain cost components, including energy,
freight and some input categories. Further volatility cannot be excluded,
although any impact on these cost items is expected to affect the market
broadly. The group continues to mitigate cost increases where possible through
sourcing initiatives, pricing measures and improved operational efficiency.
In Sweden, the ÖoB turnaround programme is progressing according to plan. While
the store remodelling programme is expected to continue to weigh on
profitability in the near term, the investments are expected to support the
chain's longer-term earnings capacity. The group reiterates its ambition to grow
ÖoB sales to SEK 5 billion and achieve an EBIT margin of 5% by the end of 2028.
Practicalities:
The quarterly report, presentation materials and spreadsheet with key figures
will also be available on the website https://investor.europris.no. CEO Espen
Eldal and CFO Stina C Byre will present the group's results at 08:30 CET at
Nordea's office, Essendrops gate 7, Oslo (Majorstuen). The presentation will be
held in English and transferred via live webcast and will be made available
through the website at https://investor.europris.no. It will be possible to ask
questions via the web.
For further information, please contact:
Espen Eldal, CEO, +47 48 29 24 24, espen.eldal@europris.no
Stina C Byre, CFO, +47 41 10 58 08, stina.byre@europris.no
Trine Engløkken, Head of IR, +47 94 05 09 37, trine.englokken@europris.no
About Europris:
The group comprises Norway's leading variety retail chain, Europris, the Swedish
retailer ÖoB, and holds full or partial ownership in the e-commerce groups
Lekekassen and Strikkemekka. The Europris chain operates 290 stores in Norway
(269 directly operated and 21 franchised locations), while ÖoB manages 92
directly operated stores throughout Sweden, and Lekekassen operates two physical
stores in Norway. The group's operations are coordinated from its head office in
Fredrikstad, Norway, with logistics centres in both Norway and Sweden.

title: Third quarter 2026 - Robust financial performance amid challenging markets
body:
Oslo, 29 October 2026
Elkem reported an EBITDA of NOK 554 million for the third quarter 2026, a
decline from NOK 646 million in the corresponding quarter last year. Elkem
Foundry Alloys and Elkem Carbon delivered robust financial results due to strong
market positions, while Elkem Silicon's results were still impacted by weak
silicon and ferrosilicon sales prices. While market conditions remain
challenging, new protective trade measures by the EU to support European
industry is expected to lift prices and strengthen demand in the period ahead.
Elkem's revised strategy will focus on developing the core business and
expanding in areas where the company holds world-leading positions.
Elkem's total operating income for the third quarter 2026 was NOK 3 587 million,
which was down 2 per cent from the third quarter 2025. Earnings before interest,
taxes, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) was NOK 554 million, down 14 per
cent from the corresponding quarter last year.
Elkem Silicon was impacted by low commodity sales prices. The division reported
a total operating income of NOK 2 142 million, a reduction of 9 per cent
compared to the third quarter last year, while EBITDA declined 43 per cent year
-on-year. Elkem Foundry Alloys reported improved results compared to both the
previous quarter and the corresponding quarter last year, supported by strong
market positions. The division reported total operating income of NOK 1 056
million, up 5 per cent compared to the third quarter last year, while the EBITDA
increased 7 per cent year-on-year. Elkem Carbon reported the best results since
the third quarter last year, with total operating income of NOK 782 million and
EBITDA of NOK 183 million.
Trade defence instruments are becoming increasingly important to protect
European industry against unfair trade practices and to restore the level
playing field. The European Commission in September initiated an interim review
of the anti-dumping duties on silicon imports from China due to persistent
Chinese overcapacity and downward pressure on export prices. The current duties
of 16.8 per cent were last renewed in 2022. The initiation signals increased EU
scrutiny of Chinese silicon exports. The investigation is expected to conclude
within 12 months and no later than 15 months after initiation. In addition, the
EU has renewed anti-dumping duties on ferrosilicon imports from China and Russia
for an additional five years. Chinese producers face a general anti-dumping duty
of 31.2 per cent, while the corresponding rate for Russian producers is 22.7 per
cent.
"While markets remain challenging, Elkem Foundry Alloys and Elkem Carbon
delivered solid financial performances in the third quarter, supported by strong
market positions. Recent EU trade policy developments point to a greater
willingness to deploy defensive trade measures to restore a level playing field
and protect Europe's strategic industrial value chains. This is encouraging, and
bolsters the market outlook for Elkem's products. Our priority is to remain
competitive through the cycle while positioning Elkem to capture profitable
growth where we have the strongest capabilities and market positions," said Dag
Teigland, CEO of Elkem.
In the third quarter, Elkem received 1.3 million additional free emission
allowances under the EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS) for the period
2021-2025 from the Norwegian Environment Agency (Miljødirektoratet). The award
follows the Norwegian Ministry of Climate and Environment's conclusion in July
2025 that Norwegian silicon, ferrosilicon and manganese producers were unequally
treated compared to EU producers in the implementation of EU ETS rules. For the
2026-2030 period, Elkem's plants in Norway have been informed that they will
receive allowances in line with comparable industrial producers in the EU,
securing a level playing field and competitive and predictable framework
conditions. Elkem holds 1.3 million surplus emission allowances, and expects to
realise these allowances over time.
Elkem has made the decision to invest NOK 260 million to renew a furnace at
Elkem Rana in Northern Norway. The investment will improve the plant's
competitiveness and facilitate increased use of biocarbon in line with Elkem's
climate ambitions. The installation is scheduled to start in the first quarter
of 2027 and last around three to four months.
Elkem Iceland and Landsvirkjun signed a new power purchase agreement (PPA) in
October 2026 which runs until March 2039, thereby securing long-term electricity
supply for the ferrosilicon plant. The agreement covers a contracted volume of
127 MW and approximately 1 035 GWh per year. The new power agreement is expected
to improve the plant's competitiveness and strategic attractiveness. This will
be an important element in the ongoing strategic review of the Iceland plant
announced in the second quarter of 2026 and the continued work to evaluate all
alternatives to secure viable operations.
Elkem's equity as at 30 September 2026 amounted to NOK 12 982 million, which
gave a ratio of equity to total assets of 45 per cent. Net interest-bearing debt
was NOK 6 459 million, which gave a ratio of net interest-bearing debt to EBITDA
of 3.3x. Elkem had cash and cash equivalents of NOK 5 459 million as at 30
September 2026, and undrawn credit lines of around NOK 4 500 million.
Elkem's cost reduction programme will continue to contribute positively to the
results going forward.
Silicon prices increased modestly in the third quarter and have continued to
rise in the fourth quarter. Expectations for the fourth-quarter result remains
stable. A continued price normalisation would further strengthen the division's
outlook for 2027. Elkem Foundry Alloys anticipates stable results, with
seasonally lower sales expected towards the end of the year. Signs of recovery
for Carbon points to a modest improvement in the fourth quarter. New protective
measures in the EU are expected to improve market conditions ahead.

title: Cadeler announces preliminary results of the successful share exchange offer by Cadeler plc to the shareholders of Cadeler A/S in connection with Cadeler's redomiciliation from Denmark to the United Kingdom, reflecting a 92.02% acceptance rate
category: ADDITIONAL REGULATED INFORMATION REQUIRED TO BE DISCLOSED UNDER THE LAWS OF A MEMBER STATE
body:
THIS ANNOUNCEMENT IS NOT A PROSPECTUS AND DOES NOT CONSTITUTE AN OFFER TO PURCHASE, OR A SOLICITATION OF AN OFFER TO SELL, ANY SECURITIES. THE OFFER IS MADE IN THE EU/EEA SOLELY BY MEANS OF THE PROSPECTUS (AS DEFINED BELOW), AND IN THE UNITED STATES, THE U.S. PROSPECTUS/OFFER TO EXCHANGE (AS DEFINED BELOW). COPIES OF THE PROSPECTUS OR THE U.S. PROSPECTUS/OFFER TO EXCHANGE, AS APPLICABLE, MAY BE OBTAINED THROUGH THE WEBSITE OF CADELER AS SET FORTH ELSEWHERE IN THIS ANNOUNCEMENT. THIS ANNOUNCEMENT IS NOT FOR RELEASE, PUBLICATION OR DISTRIBUTION, IN WHOLE OR IN PART, DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY, IN OR INTO ANY JURISDICTION IN WHICH THE RELEASE, PUBLICATION OR DISTRIBUTION IS UNLAWFUL OR REQUIRES REGISTRATION OR ANY OTHER MEASURES.
Copenhagen, 29 October 2026 - With reference to the stock exchange announcement made by Cadeler A/S ("Cadeler", and together with its consolidated subsidiaries, the "Cadeler Group") on 21 September 2026, regarding the launch of the voluntary offer by Cadeler plc to all holders of shares in Cadeler, each with a nominal value of DKK 1.00 (the "Cadeler Shares"), including Cadeler Shares represented by American Depositary Shares (each representing four (4) Cadeler Shares) ("Cadeler ADSs"), to exchange each Cadeler Share for one (1) share in Cadeler plc (the "Offer") in connection with the contemplated redomiciliation of the Cadeler Group's parent company from Denmark to the United Kingdom (the "Redomiciliation"), and stock exchange announcement made on 21 October 2026, regarding the extension of the offer period ("Offer Period") by one (1) week, Cadeler and Cadeler plc today announce the preliminary results of the Offer. 
The Offer Period expired on 28 October 2026 at 5 PM Eastern Time / 10:00 PM CET. Subject to customary verification procedures, 355,254,085 Cadeler Shares (which include 11,156,931 Cadeler Shares represented by Cadeler ADSs) have been validly tendered and not validly withdrawn in the Offer, corresponding to an acceptance rate of approximately 92.02% of the total number of outstanding shares and voting rights of Cadeler Shares, excluding any Cadeler Shares held in treasury.
The acceptance rate satisfies the minimum acceptance rate as set out in the combined EU/EEA prospectus and offer document dated 21 September 2026 (the "Prospectus"), section 17.2.3 "Conditions to the Offer", and the Registration Statement on Form F-4 under the U.S. Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the "U.S. Securities Act"), which includes an offering prospectus/offer to exchange (the "U.S. Prospectus/Offer to Exchange"). Listing and trading of the Cadeler plc shares on the New York Stock Exchange ("NYSE") and on the Oslo Stock Exchange ("OSE") is expected on or around 5 November 2026. 
The number of shares tendered in the Offer is preliminary and remains subject to potential adjustments through a verification process undertaken by the receiving agent and the exchange agent. Cadeler and Cadeler plc expect to announce the final results of the Offer on or prior to 2 November 2026.
Following completion of the Offer, each Cadeler shareholder will hold the same number of Cadeler plc shares as the number of Cadeler Shares (including Cadeler Shares represented by Cadeler ADSs) validly tendered by such shareholder in the Offer. 
"We highly appreciate the strong support shown by our shareholders for the Redomiciliation. The high acceptance rate reflects the confidence our shareholders place in the strategic rationale for moving our parent company to the United Kingdom. This is a significant step towards a corporate structure that better reflects the scale and global reach of our operations, and towards attracting a broader and more diverse international investor base. We look forward to completing the Redomiciliation", said Mikkel Gleerup, CEO of Cadeler.
Timetable of the Offer
The key dates relating to the Offer are set out below.
- Announcement by Cadeler plc with final results on whether or not the conditions to the Offer have been satisfied or, to the extent legally permitted, waived: On or prior to 2 November 2026
- Settlement will be made as promptly as possible, and is expected to take place on or around 4 November 2026(1)
- Commencement of trading of Cadeler plc shares on the NYSE: On or around 5 November 2026(2)
- Commencement of trading of Cadeler plc shares on the OSE: On or around 5 November 2026
(1) In the event that the Offer conditions have been satisfied or, if applicable, waived, Cadeler plc will accept for exchange, and will exchange, all Cadeler Shares and Cadeler ADSs that have been validly tendered into the Offer as of the expiration date and Cadeler plc will deliver the Cadeler plc shares as soon as practicable after the expiration date in accordance with applicable U.S. law and Norwegian law.
(2) It is currently expected that trading of Cadeler plc shares on the NYSE and the OSE will commence shortly after the expiration of the Offer.
Squeeze-out
As Cadeler plc at completion stands to hold more than 90% of the total number of, and the aggregate voting power of, the outstanding Cadeler Shares (excluding any treasury shares held by Cadeler), Cadeler plc intends, as promptly as practicable thereafter, to initiate and complete a compulsory acquisition of the Cadeler Shares (including Cadeler Shares represented by Cadeler ADSs) not acquired in the Offer, for cash, in accordance with the Danish Companies Act. 
To initiate the squeeze-out, Cadeler plc will publish a notice requesting that the remaining Cadeler shareholders transfer their Cadeler Shares, including Cadeler Shares represented by Cadeler ADSs (the "Squeeze-out Cadeler Shares"), to Cadeler plc, against payment of cash consideration, within a four-week period, with both the cash consideration and the four-week period set out in such notice. After the expiry of such four-week period, any Squeeze-out Cadeler Shares not committed to be transferred will be acquired compulsorily by Cadeler plc against payment of the cash

Styrene i Skue Sparebank og Romerike Sparebank har inngått avtale om sammenslåing (fusjonsplan)
body:
Det vises til børsmeldinger publisert av Skue Sparebank og Romerike Sparebank ("Bankene") den 24. september 2026 om at Bankene har inngått intensjonsavtale om sammenslåing.
Styrene i Skue Sparebank og Romerike Sparebank har i dag vedtatt en plan for sammenslåing av Bankene (fusjonsplan) basert på intensjonsavtalen. 
"Nå er vi kommet et viktig steg videre og ser frem til å legge frem fusjonsplanen for beslutning i bankenes øverste organ 8. desember 2026. Sammen skal vi skape en bank som står sterkere rustet til å møte morgendagens muligheter og utfordringer. Sammen blir vi sterkere, samtidig som vi tar vare på det som betyr mest. Vi skal bruke kraften i å være stor, til å bli enda bedre lokalt - til beste for kunder, lokalt næringsliv, eiere, ansatte og lokalmiljøet," sier adm. direktør Hans Kristian Glesne og adm. banksjef Siri Berggreen.
Skue Sparebank skal være juridisk og regnskapsrettslig overtakende bank, og overtar eiendeler, rettigheter og forpliktelser fra Romerike Sparebank ved gjennomføring av sammenslåingen. Den sammenslåtte banken skal videreføres under navnet Skue Sparebank.
Bytteforhold og vederlag
Bokført egenkapital (justert for hybridkapital) per andre kvartal 2026 er 3 681 MNOK i Skue Sparebank og 2 308 MNOK i Romerike Sparebank, samlet 5 989 MNOK. Justert for mer- og mindreverdier, er verdijustert egenkapital 3 841 MNOK i Skue Sparebank og 2 392 MNOK i Romerike Sparebank, samlet 6 233 MNOK. Samlet verdijustert egenkapital på 6 233 MNOK representerer en pris/bok på 1,04x sammenlignet med bokført egenkapital (justert for hybridkapital) per andre kvartal 2026. 
Sett hen til mer- og mindreverdier i Partenes balanser, samt normalisert resultat (analyse av historisk resultat justert for engangseffekter og estimater på framtidig inntjening), er Partene enige om et bytteforhold på 61,95 % til Skue Sparebank og 38,05 % til Romerike Sparebank.
Vederlaget for overtakelse av virksomhet fra Romerike Sparebank skal ytes i form av egenkapitalbevis i den sammenslåtte banken. Fordelingen av eierskapet i den sammenslåtte banken vil følge av bytteforholdet. 
Skue Sparebank og Romerike Sparebank har forut for Sammenslåingen en kapitalstruktur bestående av grunnfondskapital og eierandelskapital. Eierbrøken per andre kvartal 2026 er beregnet til 45,12 % for Skue Sparebank og 45,00 % for Romerike Sparebank. Eierbrøken i Romerike Sparebank per andre kvartal 2026 hensyntar etableringen av Sparebankstiftelsen Romerike Sparebank som ble gjennomført 22. august 2026.
Hensyntatt bytteforholdet og vederlaget til dagens eiere i Romerike Sparebank, er Partene enige om at den sammenslåtte banken skal ha en eierbrøk på ca. 45,07 % basert på tall per andre kvartal 2026. Eierbrøken kan som følge av Partenes utdeling av utbytte og gaver frem mot gjennomføring av Sammenslåingen endres. Eierbrøken i den sammenslåtte banken skal på Gjennomføringsdato beregnes som den gjennomsnittlige eierbrøken i de to Partene, hensyntatt etablering av Sparebankstiftelsen Romerike Sparebank og det avtalte bytteforholdet. 
Egenkapitalbevis som utstedes som vederlag til dagens eiere i Romerike Sparebank, utstedes til kurs NOK 338,2960, som tilsvarer volumvektet børskurs siste måned på egenkapitalbevisene utstedt av Skue Sparebank på tidspunkt for vedtak av fusjonsplan. 
Hensyntatt bytteforholdet og justeringer for mer- og mindreverdier i bankene skal det utstedes 3 540 811 egenkapitalbevis til nåværende eiere i Romerike Sparebank, herunder 2 276 312 egenkapitalbevis til Sparebankstiftelsen Romerike Sparebank og 1 264 499 egenkapitalbevis til øvrige eiere. Fra før har Skue Sparebank utstedt 5 778 719 egenkapitalbevis, per andre kvartal 2026. Etter Sammenslåingen vil det være totalt 9 319 530 utstedte egenkapitalbevis. Ingen av Partene har egenbeholdning av egenkapitalbevis per andre kvartal 2026. Dette gir følgende fordeling av eierandelskapitalen i den sammenslåtte banken:
Egenkapitalbeviseiere Antall EKB Eierandel

Tidsplan og betingelser for gjennomføring
Sammenslåingen er blant annet betinget av godkjennelse av fusjonsplanen i Bankenes respektive generalforsamling og representantskap, som etter tidsplanen skal behandle fusjonsplanen den 8. desember 2026. Sammenslåingen er også betinget av nødvendige godkjennelser fra Finanstilsynet og Konkurransetilsynet. 
Det tas sikte på å gjennomføre sammenslåingen på eller omkring 1. september 2027.
Bankene har engasjert Norne Securities AS som felles finansiell rådgiver i forbindelse med sammenslåingen, mens Advokatfirmaet Selmer AS er engasjert som felles juridisk rådgiver.

KONGSBERG cancels and relaunches the 2026 employee share programme
category: ACQUISITION OR DISPOSAL OF AN ISSUER'S OWN SHARES
body:
Kongsberg Gruppen ASA (KONGSBERG, OSE: KOG) has decided to cancel its 2026 employee share programme and introduce an updated and revised employee share programme on 30 October 2026.
As announced on 31 August 2026, 5,333 employees, including primary insiders, subscribed for shares under the programme.
KONGSBERG is subject to the EU Market Abuse Regulation (MAR), including rules applicable to trading in the company's own shares. Due to the regulatory framework applicable to the planned share purchases, KONGSBERG has not been able to initiate the purchases of shares. This was due to being in an active insider position for a prolonged time. 
The underlying assumptions for the original subscription have changed to such an extent that the company considers it no longer valid. As a result, KONGSBERG is cancelling the programme and initiating a new subscription process. All subscriptions under the existing 2026 programme will therefore be cancelled, including the subscriptions made by primary insiders as announced on 31 August 2026.
No shares have been acquired or allocated pursuant to these subscriptions.
On 30 October 2026, KONGSBERG plans to relaunch the revised 2026 employee share programme.

title: KONGSBERG kansellerer og relanserer ansattaksjeprogrammet for 2026
category: ACQUISITION OR DISPOSAL OF AN ISSUER'S OWN SHARES
body:
Kongsberg Gruppen ASA (KONGSBERG, OSE: KOG) har besluttet å kansellere sitt ansattaksjeprogram for 2026 og innføre et oppdatert og revidert ansattaksjeprogram 30. oktober 2026.
Som kunngjort 31. august 2026, tegnet 5 333 ansatte, inkludert primærinnsidere, aksjer under programmet.
KONGSBERG er underlagt EUs markedsmisbruksforordning (MAR), inkludert regler for handel med selskapets egne aksjer. På grunn av det regulatoriske rammeverket som gjelder for planlagte aksjekjøp, har KONGSBERG ikke kunnet igangsette aksjekjøp. Dette skyldtes at selskapet har hatt en aktiv insiderposisjon over lengre tid. 
Forutsetningene som lå til grunn for det opprinnelige programmet har endret seg vesentlig. Selskapet har derfor besluttet å avslutte det opprinnelige programmet og lansere et nytt program på reviderte vilkår.
Som følge av dette kansellerer KONGSBERG programmet og starter en ny tegningssprosess. Alle tegninger under det eksisterende 2026-programmet vil derfor bli kansellert, inkludert tegningene gjort av primæreinnsidere som kunngjort 31. august 2026.
Ingen aksjer er blitt anskaffet eller tildelt i henhold til disse tegningene.
Den 30. oktober 2026 planlegger KONGSBERG å relansere det reviderte ansattaksjeprogrammet for 2026.

title: KONGSBERG enter into agreement for purchase of own shares for employee share programme
category: ACQUISITION OR DISPOSAL OF AN ISSUER'S OWN SHARES
body:
Kongsberg Gruppen ASA (KONGSBERG, OSE: KOG) has mandated DNB Markets to purchase shares with a value up to MNOK 220. The mandate is related to the share programme for employees.
Pursuant to the mandate agreement, DNB Markets will start the purchasing of shares to this programme on or about 23 November 2026 and until 20 December 2026. If volumes defined by the safe harbor regulations are too low for the programme to be completed within this time period, the time period will be extended by 30 days, but in no case exceed the time limit set out in the power of attorney granted. The total amount will be determined based on the total commitment by the employees but will not exceed MNOK 220. 
The shares will be transferred to employees who have chosen to participate in the programme at a later time. DNB Markets will make its own decisions related to the purchase of the shares independently of, and without influence from the company regarding the timing of purchase. 
The shares will be purchased in accordance with the applicable securities law and regulations, as well as the effective power of attorney related to purchase of own shares granted by the Company's General Assembly.

title: KONGSBERG inngår avtale om kjøp av egne aksjer til ansattaksjeprogrammet
category: ACQUISITION OR DISPOSAL OF AN ISSUER'S OWN SHARES
body:
Kongsberg Gruppen ASA (KONGSBERG, OSE: KOG) har tildelt et mandat til DNB Markets for kjøp av aksjer for en verdi opp til MNOK 220 i KONGSBERG. Mandatet er knyttet til tilbakekjøp av aksjer til selskapets aksjeprogram for ansatte. 
I henhold til mandatavtalen vil DNB Markets starte kjøp av aksjer til dette programmet rundt 23. november 2026 og frem til 20. desember 2026. Dersom volumene innenfor safe harbour forordningen er for lave til at programmet kan gjennomføres innen tidsperioden, vil den forlenges med 30 dager, men ikke under noen omstendighet overstige frist fastsatt i fullmakt fra selskapets generalforsamling. Det totale beløpet avgjøres av tegningen fra de ansatte, men vil ikke overstige NOK 220 millioner. 
Aksjene vil bli tildelt og overført til ansatte som har valgt å delta i programmet på et senere tidspunkt. DNB Markets vil ta egne beslutninger knyttet til kjøp av aksjene uavhengig av, og uten innflytelse fra selskapet med hensyn til tidspunktet for kjøpet.
Aksjene vil bli kjøpt i samsvar med gjeldende verdipapirlovgivning og forskrifter, samt den effektive fullmakten knyttet til kjøp av egne aksjer gitt av selskapets generalforsamling.

title: Borregaard ASA: Statkraft and Borregaard enter into 10-year power supply agreement
category: ADDITIONAL REGULATED INFORMATION REQUIRED TO BE DISCLOSED UNDER THE LAWS OF A MEMBER STATE
body:
Statkraft and Borregaard have entered into a new long-term power supply
agreement. Deliveries will start on 1 November 2026 and continue until the end
of 2036. The total volume is 445 GWh, covering around 5% of Borregaard's power
consumption.
"This agreement will form part of our long-term power supply and is expected to
contribute to a lower average power price by reducing our exposure to the spot
market. At the same time, the agreement is important to our strategy for
electrification and reducing greenhouse gas emissions," says Tom Erik Foss-
Jacobsen, CEO of Borregaard.
"We are currently seeing strong interest in various types of power agreements
that provide industry and businesses with greater predictability in future
electricity costs. At the same time, we are particularly pleased that an
innovative and forward-looking company such as Borregaard has renewed its
confidence in us," says Hallvard Granheim, Executive Vice President Markets at
Statkraft.
The new agreement supplements the long-term power supply agreement entered into
by the two companies in 2019.

About Statkraft
Statkraft is a leading international hydropower company and Europe's largest
generator of renewable energy. The Group produces hydropower, wind power, solar
power and gas-fired power. Statkraft is a global company in energy market
operations. Statkraft has around 6,200 employees in 20 countries.
About Borregaard
Borregaard operates one of the world's most advanced and sustainable
biorefineries. By using natural and renewable raw materials, the company
produces advanced and environmentally friendly biochemicals that can replace
oil-based products. With 1,150 full-time equivalents at production sites and
sales offices in 13 countries across Europe, Asia and the Americas, the company
serves customers worldwide. 96% of sales are generated outside Norway.

Market Abuse Regulation.

title: Correction: Sparebanken Møre strengthening its position as market leader
body:
Reference is made to the stock exchange announcement published on 29 October 2026 at 07:00 CET.
A minor error has been identified on page 22 of the attachment "SBM Presentation Q3 2026.pdf", concerning the reported figure for net market funding. The correct figure is NOK 45.9 billion, rather than NOK 56.5 billion as stated in the original version.
Please find attached a corrected version of the relevant document, as well as other attachments which are unchanged. Note that this correction does not affect any other financial figures or financial results as reported and presented.
-
Sparebanken Møre has delivered strong lending growth in both the retail and corporate markets, while expenses remain stable and losses are low.
Profit after tax for the third quarter amounted to NOK 262 million, NOK 4 million higher than for the same quarter last year. The return on equity was 12.0 per cent, compared with 12.2 per cent for the same period in 2025.
Growth in both customer segments
Sparebanken Møre's corporate lending has increased by 9.4 per cent in the past 12 months, while retail lending has increased by 5.3 per cent. In total, lending grew by 6.7 per cent, well above market growth. Both new and existing customers are contributing to the growth.
"We continue to take market share in Nordvestlandet in a highly competitive market. Professional advisors who understand their customers and local business community are a key factor behind the growth. At the same time, digital solutions are freeing up time that we can then spend advising and following up customers. We're also seeing good growth outside the region," says Trond Lars Nydal, CEO of Sparebanken Møre.
A strong housing market
The housing market in Møre og Romsdal is performing well, and prices have risen sharply in 2026. However, compared with other parts of the country, prices remain moderate and well below the national average.
"Residential mortgage demand remains strong despite the rate hike, and the number of customers asking for interest-only periods or payment relief remains low. At the same time, we're monitoring developments closely and prepared for the fact that our customers' situations could change," says Nydal.
Stable expenses and low losses
Expenses remain stable and largely unchanged from last year, and losses are low. Bankruptcy figures for Møre og Romsdal have generally mirrored national trends, and the number of bankruptcies is on a downwards trend. Recognised losses amounted to NOK 11 million for the third quarter, compared with NOK 24 million for the same quarter of 2025.
"Expenses were on a par with previous quarters. The fact that we can generate growth without increasing our cost base tells us that we can operate a more efficient bank. Furthermore, we can also see that losses are stable and low," says Nydal.
Good levels of activity in our region, Nordvestlandet
The uncertainty in the global economy is considerable, but the Norwegian economy has so far proven resilient. Activity in Nordvestlandet remains strong, particularly in certain sectors of industry and the maritime sector. At the same time, higher interest rates mean that the market conditions for industries such as construction and civil engineering remain challenging. Nonetheless, overall, our region is expected to see a good level of activity going forward.

title: Korreksjon: Sparebanken Møre styrker posisjonen som markedsleder
body:
Det vises til børsmelding publisert 29.10.2026 kl. 07:00 CET.
Det er avdekket en mindre feil i vedlegget "SBM Regnskapspresentasjon Q3 2026.pdf" knyttet til tallet for netto markedsfinansiering på side 22. Riktig tall skal være 45,9 milliarder kroner, ikke 56,5 milliarder kroner som oppgitt i opprinnelig versjon.
Vedlagt følger en korrigert versjon av det aktuelle vedlegget, samt øvrige vedlegg som er uendret. Vi gjør oppmerksom på at korrigeringen ikke påvirker øvrige regnskapstall eller finansielle resultater slik disse er fremlagt og presentert.
-
Sparebanken Møre leverer sterk utlånsvekst i både person- og næringslivsmarkedet, samtidig som kostnadene er stabile og tapene lave.
I tredje kvartal ble resultatet etter skatt 262 mill. kroner, 4 mill. kroner høyere enn i samme kvartal i fjor. Egenkapitalavkastningen landet på 12,0 prosent, mot 12,2 prosent i samme periode i 2025.
Vokser i begge kundemarkeder
Sparebanken Møres utlån til næringslivet har økt med 9,4 prosent de siste 12 månedene, mens utlån til personkunder har økt med 5,3 prosent. Samlet utlånsvekst er på 6,7 prosent, noe som ligger godt over markedsveksten. Både nye og eksisterende kunder bidrar til økningen.
- Vi fortsetter å ta markedsandeler på Nordvestlandet i et marked med sterk konkurranse. Dyktige rådgivere som kjenner kundene og det lokale næringslivet, er en viktig årsak til veksten. Samtidig frigir digitale løsninger tid som vi kan bruke på rådgivning og oppfølging av kundene. Vi opplever også god vekst utenfor regionen, sier Trond Lars Nydal, adm. direktør i Sparebanken Møre.
Et solid boligmarked
Det er god utvikling i boligmarkedet i Møre og Romsdal, og prisutviklingen i 2026 har vært sterk. Sammenlignet med andre deler av landet er prisnivået likevel fortsatt moderat og godt under landsgjennomsnittet.
- Etterspørselen etter boliglån er god til tross for rentehevingen, og antall kunder som ber om avdragsfrihet eller betalingslettelser holder seg på et lavt nivå. Samtidig er vi tett på og forberedt på at kundenes situasjon kan endre seg, sier Nydal.
Stabile kostnader og lave tap
Kostnadsnivået er stabilt og om lag uendret fra fjoråret, og tapene er lave. Konkurstallene i Møre og Romsdal følger i all hovedsak de nasjonale svingningene, og antall konkurser viser en fallende trend. I tredje kvartal ble det bokført tap på 11 mill. kroner mot 24 mill. kroner i samme kvartal i 2025.
- Kostnadene ligger på samme nivå som i de foregående kvartalene. At vi klarer å skape vekst uten å øke kostnadsbasen, forteller oss at vi klarer å drive en mer effektiv bank. Videre ser vi også at tapene holder seg på et lavt nivå, sier Nydal.
God aktivitet på Nordvestlandet
Usikkerheten i internasjonal økonomi er stor, men norsk økonomi har så langt vist seg å være robust. På Nordvestlandet er aktiviteten fortsatt god, særlig innen deler av industrien og den maritime næringen. Høyere rentenivå gjør samtidig at markedsforholdene for næringer som bygg og anlegg fortsetter å være krevende. Samlet ventes det likevel et godt aktivitetsnivå i regionen vår fremover.

title: Endúr ASA - BMO to acquire F15 Bergteknik & F15 Anläggning
category: ADDITIONAL REGULATED INFORMATION REQUIRED TO BE DISCLOSED UNDER THE LAWS OF A MEMBER STATE
body:
30 October 2026 - BMO Entreprenør AS ("BMO"), a wholly owned subsidiary of Endúr ASA ("Endúr"), is happy to announce its planned acquisition of 100% of the shares in F15 Bergteknik AB ("F15BT") and F15 Anläggning AB ("F15A"), through BMO Fjell AS ("BMO Fjell"). F15BT and F15A will operate as subsidiaries of BMO Fjell, joining forces with Norsk Bergsikring AS ("NBS") and Wimo Fjellsikring AS ("Wimo").
F15BT is a niche contractor specializing in vibration-free rock splitting and rockfall protection, while F15A is a spin-off providing related groundworks and civil engineering services. Based in Bålsta, between Uppsala and Stockholm, the companies operate across Sweden and provide vibration-free rock splitting, drilling, bolting and mesh installation, shotcreting, wire sawing and grouting, as well as groundworks, water and sewer infrastructure and mass handling. The companies primarily act as subcontractors to larger Swedish contractors.
Founder and General Manager, Fredrik Nilsson, holds 100% of F15BT and 76% of F15A, while Operations Manager, Christopher Gustafsson, holds the remaining 24% of F15A. Both will remain in their current positions following the completion of the transaction. The companies bring valuable resources and expertise to complement and geographically expand BMO Fjell's existing service offerings and markets. F15BT and F15A will continue to operate as independent companies, but in close partnership with NBS and Wimo, under joint ownership by BMO Fjell.
"We are very pleased to continue investing, and expanding our presence, in an attractive market for rock engineering services in Norway and Sweden", says Aleksander Rød, General Manager of BMO.
The acquisition values the companies at a combined base enterprise value on cash- and debt-free basis, excluding leasing liabilities ("Base EV") of SEK 38.5 million. The companies expect to report consolidated FY 2026 revenues of around SEK ~25 million, with a consolidated operating result ("EBIT") of around SEK ~7 million (28%). In addition to a sound strategic rationale, the acquisition will be highly accretive with an implied EV/EBIT multiple of 5.5x. The acquisition adds approximately SEK ~20 million to Endúr's existing backlog.
The Base EV may be adjusted upwards or downwards by an additional consideration of up to SEK +24/-20 million ("The Additional Consideration"), to be settled by 30 June 2030. Within this range, The Additional Consideration will be calculated as the difference between cumulative and consolidated EBIT for the 2026-2029 period and a target of SEK 28 million, multiplied by 1.4x. This adjustment mechanism ensures an EV/EBIT multiple of approximately 5.5x for an average EBIT during the 2026-2029 period within a range of SEK 3.4-11.3 million.
The acquisition will be partly financed with a SEK 20 million seller's credit, to be settled by 30 June 2030 and offsetable against any negative Additional Consideration. The sellers will also receive consideration shares in Endúr of SEK 8.5 million, valued at the shares' volume weighted average price ("VWAP") on The Oslo Stock Exhange for the last 15 trading days leading up to this announcement. The consideration shares will be subject to lock-up restrictions, being released with 1/3 every 12 months after closing.
A signed share purchase agreement ("SPA") is in place and the acquisition is expected to close during Q4 in 2026, with completion being subject to certain customary conditions.
Advokatfirmaet Bull acted as legal advisor to Endúr.
For further comments, contact:
Media:

Jeppe Raaholt, CEO of Endúr: +47 976 69 759
Investors:

About Endúr:
Endúr ASA (XOSL: ENDUR) is a leading Scandinavian contractor headquartered in Lysaker and listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange. The company specializes in critical infrastructure, including bridges, quays, tunnels, and dams. Operating as a disciplined serial acquirer (compounder), the group utilizes a decentralized model that grants subsidiaries high autonomy to preserve their technical expertise and local market positions. Endúr drives long-term value through strategic platform acquisitions and targeted bolt-ons in fragmented niche markets.

Building a strong national savings bank
body:
Sparebanken Norge reports a pre-tax profit of NOK 2,138 million in the third quarter of 2026. The return on equity (ROE) is 12.7% while return on equity adjusted for merger effects (ROTE) amounted to 14.5% for the quarter. Year-to-date, return on equity is 14.2%, while return on equity adjusted for merger-related effects is 16.2%.
Strong lending growth in both the corporate and retail market
Gross lending to customers amounted to NOK 513.2 billion at the end of the third quarter. Lending to retail customers increased by 1.4% during the quarter, while lending to corporate customers increased by 2.2%.
The bank is on track with the expansion into new market areas and, during the quarter, completed key appointments of advisors and managers. Over the course of the next 12 months, Sparebanken Norge will establish a presence in two additional places: Mo i Rana and Trondheim.
"We are delivering another quarter of strong loan growth. Growth in both the retail and corporate segments remains robust and reflects focused efforts over time. At the same time, we are seeing the new market areas start to generate growth, which is encouraging for the growth journey the Bank is now on," says CEO Jan Erik Kjerpeseth.
Strong cost control despite merger-related costs and investments in new market areas
Operating expenses as a percentage of net operating income were 31.8 (29.4) % in the quarter and 31.8 (28.4) % year-to-date. Adjusted for merger-related costs, the cost-to-income ratio year-to-date would have been approximately 31.0 %. 
"We have maintained strong cost control in 2026, despite a year characterized by significant merger-related costs and limited realization of cost synergies. The successful technical merger completed in October 2026, together with workforce adjustments, will significantly accelerate the realization of synergies heading into 2027," says Kjerpeseth.
Strong capital position provides room for both growth and dividends going forward The CET1 capital ratio was 18.1 (18.1) % at the end of the quarter. At quarter-end, the Bank`s capital buffer above its capital target was approximately 2.2 percentage points.
"We are a well-capitalised bank with a conservative loan portfolio and low risk profile. Over time, we aim to operate with capital efficiency, and at present we have the capacity both to achieve our ambitious growth targets and to offer competitive dividends," says Kjerpeseth.
Highlights - third quarter 2026 
- Return on equity of 12.7 (14.5) %
- Net interest income of NOK 2,664 (2,760) million
- Net fee and commission income of NOK 493 (452) million
- Cost-to-income ratio of 31.8 (29.4) %, despite merger-related costs of approximately NOK 26 million
- Impairment losses on loans and guarantees of NOK 97 (73) million
- Earnings per equity certificate of NOK 3.66 (4.01)
- Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) ratio of 18.1 (18.1) %, well above the capital target of 15.9 %

Questions may be submitted to investorrelations@sbnorge.no before or during the presentation and will be addressed following the presentation. A recording of the presentation will be made available via the same link later that day.
